Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is his main damage source and knocks you up, so when you see the cast animation, move outside the blade tip's range or step inside it. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits, leave its area immediately and save Akali E Shuriken Flip for when you need it. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, his healing increases, so create distance and wait for it to expire.
Aatrox.build: Aatrox deals mainly physical damage and Akali has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps. If fights run long and he heals through Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance, Aatrox E Umbral Dash, and Aatrox R World Ender, build armor first, then add healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
Aatrox.fight: Take a short trade just after Aatrox uses his Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance empowered attack on a minion. Hit with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow him and create a passive ring, step back across the ring, then return with the increased range of your empowered attack. Engage when Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down. If Aatrox R World Ender is active, stop fighting and create distance.
Aatrox.laning: As Akali Q Five Point Strike gains levels, use its edge to poke and follow with Akali P Assassin's Mark empowered attacks to gain a health advantage. Once you have that advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Aatrox.combo: Avoid the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. When Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross its edge, then return to land an empowered attack.
Aatrox.escape: Right after you force Aatrox E Umbral Dash, use Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution to close the gap. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, leave its area first; save a mobility ability for that.
Aatrox.phase: Akali is weak early, and Aatrox can easily build a lead, so prioritize avoiding deaths. After completing one ability power core item, you can pick off the backline, but a failed finish puts you at risk, so choose your engages carefully even late in the game.
Aatrox.teamfight: Do not start the teamfight as Akali. Wait for your allies to engage, draw the enemy's attention, and use up the enemy's crowd control. Then dive a squishy backline target and kill them quickly. Avoid extended duels with Aatrox while Aatrox R World Ender is active.

Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits, you may take her entire follow-up combo, so keep minions between you and her. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can also hit on its return; after dodging the first pass, move out of its return path.
Ahri.build: If healing from Ahri P Essence Theft lets her survive your attempt to kill her, add healing reduction with Morellonomicon. Build magic resistance against Ahri's magic damage, but prioritize dodging Ahri E Charm. Magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from the return of Ahri Q Orb of Deception.
Ahri.fight: When Ahri E Charm is down or Ahri R Spirit Rush is unavailable, close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Ahri.laning: Keep the minion wave between you and Ahri to avoid Ahri E Charm while poking with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike. Even if you miss some farm, follow up with empowered attacks to gain a health advantage. Once ahead in health, push the wave and move to another lane.
Ahri.combo: For a basic trade, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then return with the increased range of your empowered attack.
Ahri.escape: Your windows to engage are right after you dodge Ahri E Charm and when Ahri R Spirit Rush is down.
Ahri.phase: After completing one ability power core item, target the backline, but choose your engage carefully because failing to finish the kill puts you at risk.
Ahri.teamfight: Enter after your team starts the fight and the enemy's attention and crowd control have been used. Check that Ahri E Charm is down and target Ahri in the backline. Account for her ability to create distance if Ahri R Spirit Rush is still available.

Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits a target, so dodge both passes even behind minions. Akshan E Heroic Swing lets him engage and escape using walls, so do not chase too aggressively near them. If you are low on health and the targeting indicator for Akshan R Comeuppance appears, move behind terrain to block the shots.
Akshan.build: Akshan deals mainly physical damage, and Akali has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Akshan.fight: Hit with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Akshan and create a passive ring, step back outside it, then return with an empowered attack. Right after you force Akshan E Heroic Swing, you can close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution. You can also interrupt Akshan E Heroic Swing by walking into its path ahead of him.
Akshan.laning: Farm while dodging Akshan Q Avengerang, and build a health advantage with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered attacks. Once ahead in health, push the wave and move to another lane.
Akshan.combo: When Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross its edge, then return with an empowered attack. If Akali E Shuriken Flip hits, cross the ring to land an empowered attack, then recast it to close the gap and land another empowered attack.
Akshan.escape: Akshan E Heroic Swing is his only mobility ability, so engage right after he uses it. Close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution, but before recasting Akali E Shuriken Flip, check whether Akshan has moved under a turret or into enemy territory.
Akshan.phase: After completing one ability power core item, target the backline, but choose your engage carefully because failing to finish the kill puts Akali at risk.
Akshan.teamfight: After your team starts the fight and the enemy's attention and crowd control have been used, use Akali's mobility to reach the backline and pick off a vulnerable target. If you killed one of Akshan's allies and gained the Scoundrel mark, avoid facing him alone and fight outside his finishing range. If Akshan R Comeuppance targets you while you are low on health, move behind terrain.

Annie.watch: When the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, stay out of Annie's ability range. Spread out so several teammates do not get hit by the area attack from Annie R Summon: Tibbers, and keep your distance from Tibbers after he is summoned.
Annie.build: First, build enough magic resistance to survive one round of Annie's magic damage. Movement speed also helps you leave the area of her telegraphed attacks.
Annie.fight: After Annie uses the stun from Annie P Pyromania, poke with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike. Annie has no mobility ability, so once you have a health advantage, close the gap with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Annie.laning: Even if you miss some farm, gain a health advantage, then push the wave and move to another lane.
Annie.combo: Create a passive ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered attack.
Annie.escape: Do not engage while the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready. If she has just used it, take advantage of her lack of mobility and close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Annie.phase: Afterward, a failed finish still puts you at risk, so engage when Annie's stun is down.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready or Annie is out of sight, do not stand on top of an ally. After your team initiates and the enemy's crowd control has been used, Akali should target a vulnerable backliner, including Annie. Before going in, confirm that Annie's stun has been used.

Ambessa.watch: When Ambessa W Repudiation’s shield and windup appear, stop attacking and walk out of range. The edge of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam is dangerous, so dodge the first hit; if dodging is difficult, move closer to her. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, do not wait for the slow to wear off. Use Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution to avoid the follow-up. Ambessa R Public Execution grabs the farthest champion along its line, so do not stand in line with your backline during a standoff.
Ambessa.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ambessa deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first. If healing from Ambessa R Public Execution lets her survive fights, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Ambessa.fight: Hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Ambessa, step outside the Akali P Assassin's Mark ring, then return with an empowered basic attack for a short trade. Do not attack during the windup of Ambessa W Repudiation. Back off, then counterattack just after she spends her abilities and Ambessa P Drakehound's Step charges.
Ambessa.laning: As Akali Q Five Point Strike gains levels, use its tip and your empowered basic attack to build a health advantage, even if that costs you a little CS. Once ahead, push the wave and move to another lane.
Ambessa.combo: After Ambessa W Repudiation is down, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, retreat across its edge, then land the empowered basic attack.
Ambessa.escape: Go in just after Ambessa spends the dashes and charges from Ambessa P Drakehound's Step that follow her abilities. Check that Ambessa E Lacerate and Ambessa W Repudiation are also down, then close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Ambessa.phase: Even late in the game, failing to finish a target puts Akali in danger. Do not start the fight, and choose your target carefully.
Ambessa.teamfight: After your team starts the fight, draws the enemy’s attention, and uses up the enemy’s crowd control, use Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution to reach the backline. During a standoff, position so your backline is not at the far end of Ambessa R Public Execution’s line.

Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost can detonate midflight and stun, so do not dodge only slightly to the side of the projectile. If you are close, move toward Anivia and past the blast radius. If it hits you, or you are inside a fully formed Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage. Immediately use Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution to leave the storm. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape.
Anivia.build: Anivia’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If her healing makes it hard to finish her during a brief engage, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Anivia.fight: Once Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution. If Anivia P Rebirth is available, go in with your team instead of trying to secure the kill alone.
Anivia.laning: Early on, build a health advantage with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks, even if you miss a little CS. Once ahead, push the wave and move to another lane.
Anivia.combo: Create a passive ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, retreat across its edge, then land the empowered basic attack with its increased range. If Akali E Shuriken Flip lands its mark, you can chain the empowered basic attack after crossing the ring with another empowered basic attack after the E recast dash, but check Anivia’s position before the recast.
Anivia.escape: Anivia has no mobility ability, so close the gap after the stun from Anivia Q Flash Frost is down. If Q hits you during the engage, stop fighting and use Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution to leave Anivia R Glacial Storm and avoid the next Anivia E Frostbite. Anivia W Crystallize can cut off your escape in narrow paths, so start fights in open space.
Anivia.phase: Late in the game, account for the terrain control from Anivia W Crystallize and go in after your team starts the fight.
Anivia.teamfight: Do not start the teamfight as Akali. Enter the backline after your team engages and draws the enemy’s attention and crowd control. Fight in open space when possible because Anivia W Crystallize can block narrow paths, and save Flash in case the wall separates you from your team. Once you go in, decide whether to finish Anivia based on whether Anivia P Rebirth has been used and whether your team can help destroy the egg.

Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when it returns, and its return damage increases with the amount of missing health. If cursed, move off the line between you and Aurora; if you are low on health, back away before it returns. Entering or leaving the area of Aurora R Between Worlds slows you, so leave before she casts it or move in prepared to fight inside.
Aurora.build: If healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration lets her sustain, consider Morellonomicon first for Grievous Wounds. Build magic resistance against the damage from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, Aurora Q Twofold Hex, and Aurora E The Weirding. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Aurora.fight: Use the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Aurora and create a passive ring. Back away across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark. Even after forcing Aurora E The Weirding, check whether Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora R Between Worlds are still available. Do not force your abilities while Aurora W Across the Veil conceals her; wait until she reappears.
Aurora.laning: As Akali Q Five Point Strike gains levels, use its tip to harass and empowered basic attacks from Akali P Assassin's Mark to build a health advantage. Even if you miss some farm, get that advantage, then push the wave and move to another lane.
Aurora.combo: Create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, retreat across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark. Even if Akali E Shuriken Flip marks Aurora, check her position before recasting to dash if she has moved under her turret or into her team.
Aurora.escape: After forcing Aurora E The Weirding, go back in during the window when Aurora W Across the Veil is also down. Use the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud and the dashes from Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution to close the gap.
Aurora.phase: Even late in the game, failing to finish the kill is dangerous, so go in after Aurora’s mobility abilities are down.
Aurora.teamfight: Enter the backline as Akali after your team starts the fight and draws the enemy’s attention and crowd control. If Aurora used Aurora W Across the Veil to engage and a takedown has not reset its cooldown, you have a window to kill her. If an ally is killed, Aurora W Across the Veil may become available again, so do not leave a low-health ally behind when retreating.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health and builds Stardust, so stand behind minions and quickly leave its line of fire if you enter it. When low on health, avoid Aurelion Sol E Singularity’s execute area; if caught in it, move outward immediately. Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend stuns, and after he builds Stardust it gains an area knockup and shockwave, so keep your distance from allies late in the game.
AurelionSol.build: Aurelion Sol’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Because Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health, consider enough health to stay above Aurelion Sol E Singularity’s execute threshold and enough movement speed to leave its area, rather than stacking health alone.
AurelionSol.fight: Once Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, close the gap with the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud and the dashes from Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution. Move off Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light’s line of fire as you land passive empowered basic attacks so you do not take sustained damage from it.
AurelionSol.laning: Early on, harass from behind minions so you do not take unnecessary hits from Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light and give him Stardust. Even if you miss a little CS, build a health advantage with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks from Akali P Assassin's Mark. Once ahead, push the wave and move to another lane to extend your lead.
AurelionSol.combo: Create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, retreat across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark.
AurelionSol.escape: Your chance to engage comes just after you force Aurelion Sol to use Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, his only mobility ability.
AurelionSol.phase: Late in the game, the permanent Stardust from Aurelion Sol P Cosmic Creator makes him harder to kill the same way, so it is better to hold back his growth early.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Do not start the teamfight. Enter the backline after your team engages and draws the enemy’s attention and crowd control. Keep your distance from allies so several of you are not hit by a Stardust-empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, and avoid grouping together in narrow passages. Pick off a vulnerable target while Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, but check where you can escape if you fail to finish the kill.

Azir.watch: Azir Q Conquering Sands slows, and Azir R Emperor's Divide pushes Akali away when she engages. Avoid the straight line where soldiers stand, and delay your engage in narrow passages with Azir R Emperor's Divide in mind.
Azir.build: Complete an ability power core item first to increase Akali's magic damage. If you build resistance against Azir's damage, choose magic resistance over armor.
Azir.fight: Your chance to approach is when the soldiers are stationary and before Azir uses Azir Q Conquering Sands again. Move around the soldiers, hit Azir himself with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike, then cross the passive ring and take a short trade with an empowered basic attack.
Azir.laning: Once you have a health advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Azir.combo: Create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Azir.escape: Right after you make Azir use Azir E Shifting Sands is your window to close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution. Engaging after Azir R Emperor's Divide is used also reduces the risk of being pushed away.
Azir.phase: In mid game, look for chances to quickly take out Azir once Akali has completed an ability power core item. Azir grows stronger as the game goes on, so avoid fights that leave you exposed to his soldiers for long in late game.
Azir.teamfight: Let your team start the fight, confirm that Azir R Emperor's Divide has been used, then go in. Do not crowd into a narrow passage together; approach Azir himself from another direction in open space.

Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, the damage and healing from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang increase while you are poisoned. Leave its range and reengage after the poison ends. You cannot use movement abilities inside Cassiopeia W Miasma, so avoid the cloud before dashing with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution. If you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze begin, turn away to avoid the stun.
Cassiopeia.build: If the healing from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang makes it hard to finish a kill after engaging, build Morellonomicon for healing reduction. Cassiopeia's Q, W, and E all deal magic damage, so choose magic resistance when building defense.
Cassiopeia.fight: Hit with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Cassiopeia and create a passive ring. Step back across the ring, then take a short trade with an empowered basic attack. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, stop trading and reengage after the poison ends. If Cassiopeia W Miasma is on the ground, go around it instead of dashing through it.
Cassiopeia.laning: As Akali Q Five Point Strike gains levels, look for a health advantage with outer edge poke and empowered basic attacks. Cassiopeia has low armor and no mobility ability, so pressure her with short trades. Once you have an advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Cassiopeia.combo: Create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no mobility ability, so right after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere is your chance to engage. If Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze has also been used, close the gap with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution. If poison clouds already cover the path, do not activate a movement ability; avoid the clouds as you approach.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Do not start the teamfight as Akali. Wait for your allies to engage and draw the enemy's attention and crowd control. Enter from the flank right after Cassiopeia uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere, or when you can cut off her path. Avoid facing Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze head-on and take out the backline quickly.

Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot can bring her in from far away using a wall and stun you, so stand away from walls and watch for her hookshot. Part of the second empowered basic attack from Camille Q Precision Protocol deals true damage, so keep your distance while she prepares it. Avoid trading damage while the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses is active. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum traps you, survive until its area ends, and do not waste your response abilities the moment she enters with her ultimate.
Camille.build: Early on, survive with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Camille's damage is mostly physical and Akali has low armor, so build armor first. If healing from Camille W Tactical Sweep makes her hard to kill, build Morellonomicon for healing reduction.
Camille.fight: Once the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses has been removed, hit with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow her and create a passive ring. Step back across the ring, then return with an empowered basic attack. When Camille prepares the second basic attack from Camille Q Precision Protocol, create distance or use the stealth from Akali W Twilight Shroud. Look for a full engage after Camille E Hookshot and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum have been used.
Camille.laning: Stand among minions away from walls, and build a health advantage with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks. Even if you miss a little CS, build a health advantage, then push the wave and move to another lane.
Camille.combo: For a short trade, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then land an empowered basic attack.
Camille.escape: Avoid the stun from Camille E Hookshot and go in during the window after Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum has also been used. Before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum comes back up, you can close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Camille.phase: From mid game onward, Camille can take towers quickly in a side lane, so do not leave side lanes unattended.
Camille.teamfight: Do not start the teamfight. Wait for your team to engage and draw the enemy's attention and crowd control. After you see an engage and crowd control such as Camille E Hookshot, enter the backline with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution to take out a vulnerable target.

Chogath.watch: When the indicator for Cho'Gath Q Rupture appears beneath you, walk sideways to dodge it and save Akali E Shuriken Flip for that moment. If the frontal silence from Cho'Gath W Feral Scream hits you, you cannot use movement abilities, so avoid facing him and walk out first. If you are at half health or lower, stay out of range of Cho'Gath R Feast, which deals true damage.
Chogath.build: If Cho'Gath sustains through the healing from Cho'Gath P Carnivore, build Morellonomicon for healing reduction. Magic resistance protects against the damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Resistances cannot reduce the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast, and stacking health alone also increases the maximum health damage from Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes.
Chogath.fight: Dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture and move out of his frontal arc to avoid Cho'Gath W Feral Scream before engaging. Cho'Gath has no mobility ability, so close in with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution, then follow up with an empowered basic attack.
Chogath.laning: Do not stand in the straight line of Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes behind minions, and look for opportunities outside the range of Cho'Gath Q Rupture. Chip away at his health with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks, but do not take unnecessary hits even if it means missing some farm. Once you have a health advantage, push the lane and move to another lane. Look for a gank opportunity right after Cho'Gath uses Cho'Gath Q Rupture on the wave.
Chogath.combo: Create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then return with the increased range of your empowered basic attack.
Chogath.escape: Your chance to engage is after Cho'Gath Q Rupture has been used and you have avoided the frontal area of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream.
Chogath.phase: Cho'Gath gains stacks over time, making the matchup less favorable. In late game, do not stay in front of him at a health level where he might kill you.
Chogath.teamfight: Akali should not start the teamfight. Enter after your team engages and draws the enemy's attention and crowd control. Watch for Cho'Gath Q Rupture and Cho'Gath W Feral Scream while targeting a vulnerable backline champion, and avoid engages where you cannot finish the kill.

Corki.watch: Corki E Gatling Gun reduces armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of standing your ground in front of him. Corki R Missile Barrage can hit you even behind minions, so get out of range and reposition, especially to avoid repeated hits from every third missile. If Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb reveals you while you retreat, immediately create distance with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Corki.build: Early on, start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against Corki’s main damage, but if you are in range of Corki E Gatling Gun, get out before building more resistances.
Corki.fight: Hit with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Corki and create a passive ring. Step back across the ring, then return with an empowered basic attack. Once Corki W Valkyrie is down, use the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud and close the gap with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Corki.laning: Then use the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks to gain a health advantage and pressure Corki’s farm. Once you have that advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Corki.combo: For short trades, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then land an empowered basic attack.
Corki.escape: Your opening to engage is right after Corki uses Corki W Valkyrie. Before then, avoid forcing your way in, since he can escape over terrain. Check where Corki lands, then chase with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Corki.phase: Corki grows stronger as he gets items, so disrupt his early farm to keep him from firing missiles freely in the mid and late game.
Corki.teamfight: Let your team start the fight. Enter the backline after the enemy’s attention and crowd control have been spent. If Corki W Valkyrie is down, use Akali’s dashes to reach him and look for a chance to take him out.

Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow with a basic attack, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so poke from outside its range. When Darius Q Decimate starts, move outside the axe blade or get close to him to reduce his healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, back away to break them, and do not stay in range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine with several stacks on you.
Darius.build: Early on, start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first because Darius’s main damage is physical, but armor cannot fully stop the penetration from Darius E Apprehend or the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine. If the healing from Darius Q Decimate lets him sustain through fights, apply healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
Darius.fight: Take short trades and disengage when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. Right after he uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions, also chip away at his health with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and an empowered basic attack. Avoid long fights that build Hemorrhage stacks. After sufficiently chipping away at his health, look to finish him with the finishing damage from Akali R Perfect Execution.
Darius.laning: Once Akali Q Five Point Strike has more ranks, poke with its edge, cross the passive ring, and return with an empowered basic attack. Even if you give up some farm, prioritize gaining a health advantage, then push the wave and move to another lane.
Darius.combo: When Darius E Apprehend is down, create a ring with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike. Step back across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Darius.escape: Darius E Apprehend missing or being on cooldown is your opening to engage. Use the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud and the mobility from Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution to close the gap.
Darius.phase: Play carefully early: Akali lacks armor and energy, while Darius is strong in chaotic fights. Once you complete an ability power core item, focus on taking out the backline. Even late, failing to finish a target or letting Darius P Hemorrhage stack for too long is dangerous.
Darius.teamfight: Do not engage first as Akali. Enter after your allies initiate and the enemy's attention and crowd control have been spent. Check whether Darius E Apprehend is down, then take out a squishy backline target. If you have several stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage, get completely out of range so Darius cannot kill you with Darius R Noxian Guillotine and reset its cooldown.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike travels in a curve, so dodge sideways instead of only backing away. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush can dash in again; move away with Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip. Do not fight up close while the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade remain.
Diana.build: Early on, prioritize enough movement speed to walk out of Diana’s telegraphed attack areas. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance for her main damage. Then complete Akali’s ability power core items to improve her finishing power.
Diana.fight: After dodging Diana Q Crescent Strike, slow her with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross the passive ring, and take a short trade with an empowered basic attack. Commit to fighting once the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone. If Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without using Diana Q Crescent Strike, slow her with Akali Q Five Point Strike and counterattack.
Diana.laning: Then prioritize gaining a health advantage with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks, even if it costs you some farm.
Diana.combo: Create a passive ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without using Diana Q Crescent Strike, use the slow from Akali Q Five Point Strike to counterattack and engage during the window when she has no way back out. If Diana Q Crescent Strike marks you, create distance because Diana E Lunar Rush can reset. Once Diana R Moonfall is down, engage with less risk of being pulled in.
Diana.phase: With ability power core items in the mid and late game, target the backline, but choose your moment to engage because failing to finish a target is dangerous.
Diana.teamfight: Keep some distance from your teammates so Diana R Moonfall cannot pull in several of you, and watch for an engage from the flank. Enter after your team starts the fight and the enemy’s attention and crowd control have been spent. When Diana’s engage abilities are down, close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution to take out a vulnerable backline target.

Ekko.watch: When you see the indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave its area to avoid the stun and shield. Also step out of the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. If you see an afterimage behind Ekko, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so do not overcommit to chasing him even if he is low on health.
Ekko.build: If the healing from Ekko R Chronobreak lets him survive a kill attempt, consider Morellonomicon first for healing reduction. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Ekko’s damage.
Ekko.fight: For short trades, hit with Akali Q Five Point Strike at its maximum range, cross the passive ring, then return with an empowered basic attack. When you see the indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, use the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud or the movement from Akali E Shuriken Flip to leave its area. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, do not rush to finish him.
Ekko.laning: Once Akali Q Five Point Strike has more ranks, gain a health advantage by poking with its edge and following with empowered basic attacks. If you have secured that advantage, push the wave and move to another lane even if you miss some CS.
Ekko.combo: Create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross its edge and land an empowered basic attack. Then mark Ekko with Akali E Shuriken Flip and follow up with another empowered basic attack.
Ekko.escape: Your opening to engage comes after both the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, do not commit to a chase because he can escape with Ekko R Chronobreak.
Ekko.phase: After completing one ability power core item, you can take out the backline, but failing to finish a target is dangerous. Check Ekko’s afterimage and which abilities he has used.
Ekko.teamfight: Enter the backline after your team starts the fight and the enemy’s attention and crowd control have been spent. If you see the indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, avoid its area. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, do not chase him just because he is low on health. Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, his movement ability is unavailable; look for a chance to take him out with your team’s crowd control.

Fiora.build: Early on, start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. If healing from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge prolongs duels, get Morellonomicon next for healing reduction.
Fiora.fight: Stand opposite Fiora's exposed vital and counter when she dashes in with Fiora Q Lunge. Hit Akali Q Five Point Strike at maximum range, step back across the Akali P Assassin's Mark ring, then return briefly with an empowered basic attack. Do not rush a major engage while Fiora W Riposte is available.
Fiora.laning: As Akali Q Five Point Strike gains levels, use hits at the edge of its range and empowered basic attacks to build a health lead. Keep trades short and do not chase Fiora too far afterward. Once you have a health lead, push the wave and roam to another lane.
Fiora.combo: After Fiora W Riposte has been fully spent, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then land the empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark.
Fiora.escape: The window for Akali to engage is right after Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora W Riposte are down. Close the gap using the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud, or use Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Fiora.teamfight: Let your team initiate the fight. Akali should enter the backline after the enemy's attention and crowd control have been spent. If Fiora R Grand Challenge marks you, stay against a wall to avoid giving her all four vitals.
Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte blocks attacks and counterattacks; if it blocks an immobilizing effect, it also stuns. While Fiora is using Riposte, don’t try to hit her with a key ability; move to the side to dodge the counterattack. If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stay close to a wall so you don’t expose all four vitals.

DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits the first target and deals damage based on current health. Be especially careful when your health is high, and dodge it from behind minions. Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma empowers a basic attack, while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage increases healing and movement speed. Avoid long duels with Mundo while his R is active.
DrMundo.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first because Dr. Mundo's main damage is physical. If his healing prolongs duels, add healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
DrMundo.fight: Hit Mundo at the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike's range to slow him and create a passive ring. Step back across the ring, then return with an empowered basic attack. Engage when Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down and you have chipped away at his health. If his R is active, do not fight for long to secure a kill.
DrMundo.laning: Keep minions between you and Dr. Mundo to block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and build a health lead with hits at the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike's range and empowered basic attacks. Step on the canister Mundo drops along your retreat path to deny its healing and passive cooldown reduction. Once ahead, push the wave and roam to another lane.
DrMundo.combo: Create a passive ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own. Block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with minions or dodge it, and engage when Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down. Close the gap with the stealth and movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud and the dashes from Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution.
DrMundo.phase: In the mid to late game, while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is available, look for an advantage in another lane or at an objective instead of fighting Mundo for long.
DrMundo.teamfight: Do not start teamfights as Akali. Let your team engage, then target a vulnerable backline enemy after the enemy's attention and crowd control have been used.

Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster is used both to engage and escape, so do not chase too far before it has been fully spent. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, use the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud to move away from your team before the shark strikes.
Fizz.build: Fizz's main damage is magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance over armor. The source does not specify a first purchase item.
Fizz.laning: After that, build a health lead with hits at the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike's range and empowered basic attacks. Trade when Fizz misses a last hit with Fizz W Seastone Trident. Once you have a health lead, push the wave and roam to another lane.
Fizz.combo: Once Fizz E Playful / Trickster has been fully spent, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Fizz.escape: Before Fizz E Playful / Trickster comes back up is Akali's opening to engage. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, he can escape with it, so do not commit too far just because his E is down. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, put distance between yourself and your team before engaging.
Fizz.phase: Failing to finish Fizz remains dangerous, so choose an opening when Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down.
Fizz.teamfight: Stand close to your team to make Fizz use Fizz E Playful / Trickster first. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your team before it detonates. Do not start the teamfight. After your team engages and the enemy's crowd control has been used, enter the backline with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.

Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg slows when it explodes, so do not enter an area with a primed keg or two overlapping kegs. If a keg is nearby, destroy it from outside its blast radius. Avoid the large area hit by Gangplank R Cannon Barrage when your health is low. Armor cannot reduce the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire or Gangplank R Cannon Barrage.
Gangplank.build: Early on, start with Cloth Armor to withstand the physical damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley and Gangplank E Powder Keg, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy prolongs fights, add healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
Gangplank.fight: Trade just after Gangplank places Gangplank E Powder Keg, while it is not yet primed. Back off if a primed keg is nearby. Hit Akali Q Five Point Strike at maximum range, cross the passive ring, then return and hit him with the empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark. Once you have chipped down his health enough to create an opening, close the gap with the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud and the dashes from Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Gangplank.laning: Build armor early against poke from Gangplank Q Parrrley. Even if you miss a few last hits, look to build a health lead with hits at the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike's range and empowered basic attacks. Once ahead, push the wave and roam to another lane.
Gangplank.combo: Create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then return with the empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is available, account for its healing when looking for a finishing opportunity.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own. Look to engage just after he places Gangplank E Powder Keg or after you destroy a nearby keg.
Gangplank.phase: Once your core ability power items are complete, use Akali's ability to kill backline targets, while keeping in mind the danger if you fail to finish them.
Gangplank.teamfight: Do not start teamfights as Akali. Let your team engage, then target a vulnerable backline enemy after the enemy's attention and crowd control have been used. Before engaging, check the positions of Gangplank E Powder Keg and whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage has been used.

Galio.watch: When Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand, he takes less damage and the taunt lasts longer. Stop dealing damage and use the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud to leave the taunt's range. Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see him step back to wind up, and move out of the area where the two gusts of Galio Q Winds of War overlap. If you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance, leave the area immediately.
Galio.build: For offense, consider magic penetration before adding more ability power. Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Galio's main damage. Galio Q Winds of War deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid relying on a large health increase alone.
Galio.fight: For a basic trade, hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to create a passive ring, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack. Stop trading and leave taunt range while Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand. Engage with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution after Galio has used his crowd control and mobility.
Galio.laning: Make Galio use abilities to clear the wave. When his mana is low, push the lane to give him less room to influence other lanes with Galio R Hero's Entrance. If the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and an empowered basic attack give you a health advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Galio.combo: After Galio W Shield of Durand has been fully spent, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross its edge, and land an empowered basic attack.
Galio.escape: Even if Galio E Justice Punch is used, do not rush an engage while Galio R Hero's Entrance is still available. Once the taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand has also been used, and before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back, use Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution to close the gap.
Galio.phase: After completing one core ability power item, you can pick off the backline. A failed finish remains dangerous in the late game, so choose your moment to engage.
Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero's Entrance is ready, do not start a skirmish against Galio's team. In teamfights, let your allies initiate, then enter the backline after Galio has used his crowd control.

Garen.watch: The empowered basic attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike silences, so do not approach first while it is active. Staying close during Garen E Judgment puts you at a greater disadvantage the longer you remain there; use the slow from Akali Q Five Point Strike and the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud to leave its range. Garen has a shield and tenacity immediately after activating Garen W Courage, so delay your damage slightly. If you are below half health, stay out of range of Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on missing health.
Garen.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment is mostly physical, so build armor first. If the healing from Garen P Perseverance lets him withstand trades, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Garen.fight: Take a short trade right after the empowered basic attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike is used on a minion or otherwise expended. Hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow him and create a passive ring, step back across its edge, then return with the empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark. Do not stay close and fight for long while Garen E Judgment is spinning, and do not unload your combo during the first moments of Garen W Courage.
Garen.laning: If you gain an advantage, push the wave and move to another lane to create a numbers advantage.
Garen.combo: After the empowered basic attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike is used, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then land the empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark.
Garen.escape: The window to engage opens after the empowered basic attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike is used. Garen has no mobility ability, so use Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution to close the gap then.
Garen.phase: In the mid game, Akali can target the backline once she completes a core ability power item. As the game goes later, the permanent stacking from Garen W Courage makes him harder to face.
Garen.teamfight: Do not start the teamfight as Akali. Let your allies initiate, then target a squishy backline champion after the enemy's attention and crowd control have been used.

Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals heavy true damage, so move sideways to avoid it when close to Gwen. While Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you cannot target Gwen from outside the mist; move inside or wait for it to end. Also watch for the slow and damage based on maximum health from Gwen R Needlework when engaging.
Gwen.build: If Gwen's healing lets her withstand trades, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon. Consider magic resistance first against her main damage, and armor if her basic attacks are a problem. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework deal damage based on maximum health, so do not rely on a large health increase alone.
Gwen.fight: From outside the range of Gwen's empowered basic attacks, hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross the passive ring, then return for a short trade with an empowered basic attack. Do not get close when Gwen Q Snip Snip! is fully stacked; look to engage right after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is used.
Gwen.laning: Keep using the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks to build a health advantage from outside Gwen's basic attack range. Once you have that advantage, push the wave and move to another lane to turn it into a gain elsewhere.
Gwen.combo: Create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Gwen.escape: Right after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is used is your chance to close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution. Check whether the slow from Gwen R Needlework has also been used before engaging.
Gwen.phase: Once you complete a core ability power item in the mid game, you can pick off the backline. A failed finish remains dangerous in the late game, so choose your target carefully.
Gwen.teamfight: Do not start the teamfight. Let your allies initiate, then target a squishy backline champion after the enemy's attention and crowd control have been used. You cannot target Gwen inside Gwen W Hallowed Mist from outside it, so move inside or wait for it to end. Go in briefly to finish the target while avoiding the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! and Gwen R Needlework.

Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss slows. Mini Gnar's boomerang can also hit on its way back, so step out of its path. Mega Gnar's Gnar R GNAR! also stuns if it knocks you into a wall, so do not fight with a wall behind you. Avoid a direct fight when his Rage bar fills and he is close to transforming.
Gnar.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Gnar's main damage is physical and Akali has low armor, so build armor first. The magic damage from Gnar W Hyper / Wallop is not reduced by armor and scales with maximum health, so be careful about relying on a large health increase alone.
Gnar.fight: While Gnar is in mini form, make him use Gnar E Hop / Crunch, then close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip. For a short trade, create a passive ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack. Create distance right after he transforms into Mega Gnar, and close in to fight again right after he returns to mini form.
Gnar.laning: Even if you miss some farm, look to build a health advantage with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks. If you gain an advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Gnar.combo: Hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Gnar and create a passive ring, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Gnar.escape: Right after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is used is a window to close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution. If he is Mega Gnar, watch for the stun and displacement from Gnar R GNAR!, and engage after that crowd control is used.
Gnar.phase: Continue to avoid direct fights with Mega Gnar. Look for a fight right after he returns to mini form or uses Gnar E Hop / Crunch.
Gnar.teamfight: Do not start the teamfight as Akali. Let your allies initiate, then enter the backline after the enemy's attention and crowd control have been used. Avoid positions with a wall behind you and narrow terrain so Gnar R GNAR! cannot knock you into a wall and stun you. Right after Mega Gnar returns to mini form, initiate a fight alongside your team during the period when he cannot transform again.

Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or displaces you, his follow-up is easy to land. If the first ability hits, immediately reposition with the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud or with Akali E Shuriken Flip to dodge the second. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster can deal damage based on maximum or missing health, so be especially careful when low.
Hwei.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Hwei's damage. Build Quicksilver Sash between your core ability power items in case Hwei E Subject: Torment catches you and leaves you open to a follow-up. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on maximum health, so do not rely on stacking health alone.
Hwei.fight: For short trades, hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Hwei and create a passive ring. Step back across the ring, then return with an empowered basic attack. Just after Hwei uses E Subject: Torment to poke or clear the wave, close the gap with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution. Use the stealth and movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud as you go in.
Hwei.laning: As Akali Q Five Point Strike gains levels, use its tip and empowered basic attacks to build a health advantage. Once you have that advantage, push the wave and move to another lane, even if it costs you some farm.
Hwei.combo: Create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then land an empowered basic attack.
Hwei.escape: The moment Hwei E Subject: Torment is down is your chance to engage.
Hwei.phase: Failing to finish Hwei remains risky, so choose a moment when Hwei E Subject: Torment is down to go in.
Hwei.teamfight: Enter after your allies start the fight and the enemy's attention and crowd control have been used. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, approach with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution to target the fragile Hwei, who has no mobility ability. Take a wide route around corridors covered by Hwei's ground effects.

Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit pulls out your spirit and slows you. Stay outside its range when last-hitting to dodge it. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on maximum health, and Illaoi R Leap of Faith deals heavy damage near tentacles, so back away when she uses her ultimate.
Illaoi.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Illaoi's main damage is physical, so build armor first. If she sustains through the healing from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, apply healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
Illaoi.fight: Hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Illaoi and create a passive ring. Step back across the ring, then take a short trade with an empowered basic attack. Close the gap just after dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit and drawing out Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Do not keep fighting where tentacles are set up.
Illaoi.laning: Build a health advantage with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks, then push the wave and move to another lane.
Illaoi.combo: Start with a trade where you create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Illaoi.escape: Your opening to engage comes just after you dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit and draw out Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Close the gap with the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud or the dashes from Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Illaoi.phase: Failing to finish Illaoi remains risky later in the game, so account for her healing and the positions of her tentacles before engaging.
Illaoi.teamfight: Destroy tentacles when you can. Otherwise, draw Illaoi away from the wall. When she uses Illaoi R Leap of Faith, spread out and wait out its duration. Akali should not start the teamfight; enter the backline after her allies initiate and the enemy's attention and crowd control have been used.

Irelia.watch: Irelia can approach by using Irelia Q Bladesurge on a low-health minion, so back away when minions are close to dying. Watch for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you are trapped inside the barrier from Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait for the blades to disappear. Crossing the barrier deals extra damage and applies a strong slow.
Irelia.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, then choose Plated Steelcaps. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first on Akali. If she sustains through healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge, buy Morellonomicon for healing reduction.
Irelia.fight: Fight after Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia E Flawless Duet are down. For short trades, hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow her and create a passive ring. Step back across it, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Irelia.laning: Do not leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia; step back when minions are close to dying. Even if you miss some farm, build a health advantage with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks. Once ahead, push the wave and move to another lane.
Irelia.combo: When Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia E Flawless Duet are down, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then land an empowered basic attack.
Irelia.escape: Just after drawing out Irelia Q Bladesurge is your chance to close the gap. Check that the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, then engage with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Irelia.phase: The provided information is insufficient to judge which champion has the advantage later in the game.
Irelia.teamfight: Enter after your allies start the teamfight and the enemy's attention and crowd control have been used. Irelia can split the fight with Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and stun multiple people with Irelia E Flawless Duet, so prioritize her whenever you can engage.

Jayce.watch: When Jayce is in cannon form and places Jayce E Acceleration Gate, anticipate Jayce Q Shock Blast and sidestep out of its path. In hammer form, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.
Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against Jayce W Lightning Field, Jayce W Hyper Charge, Jayce E Thundering Blow, and Jayce E Acceleration Gate. Magic resistance does not block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! or Jayce Q Shock Blast, so dodge by moving side to side. Jayce E Thundering Blow and Jayce E Acceleration Gate deal damage based on maximum health, so prioritize movement speed to leave the telegraphed area over stacking health alone.
Jayce.fight: Avoid forcing fights early. Create a ring with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack. Once the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Jayce Q Shock Blast and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow have been used, close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Jayce.laning: Move side to side to dodge Jayce Q Shock Blast. If health has dropped significantly, do not force yourself to stay in lane. After building a health advantage with Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks, push the wave and move to another lane.
Jayce.combo: For a short trade, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Jayce.escape: Just after the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! is down is your chance to close the gap. Check that the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow is also down, then engage with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so Akali should play defensively and wait for Akali Q Five Point Strike to gain levels. The provided information is insufficient to judge which champion has the advantage later in the game, so engage knowing that failing to finish him is risky.
Jayce.teamfight: Wait for your allies to start the fight, draw the enemy's attention, and bait out their crowd control. After the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, use Akali's mobility abilities to get close and target a fragile backline champion.

Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, even empowered basic attacks are negated. Stop basic attacks and move out of its stun range. Jax Q Leap Strike lets him close the gap, so save Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip to create distance.
Jax.build: Aim to complete a core ability power item first. If you need defense, account for the physical damage from Jax Q Leap Strike and the magic damage from Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on maximum health, so do not rely on stacking health alone.
Jax.fight: Hit with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Jax and create a passive ring. Cross the ring, then use an empowered basic attack for a short trade. If Jax E Counter Strike activates, stop basic attacks and leave its stun range. Trade again after it ends.
Jax.laning: Afterward, build a health advantage with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks. Do not force a close fight, even if you miss some farm. Once ahead, push the wave and carry that advantage to another lane.
Jax.combo: Once Jax E Counter Strike is down, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike. Step back across its edge, then land an empowered basic attack.
Jax.escape: Just after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike is a chance to close the gap. Confirm that Jax E Counter Strike has also ended, then engage with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution. While Jax E Counter Strike is active, save your mobility to escape its stun range.
Jax.phase: Jax has the advantage in a close fight at level 1, so Akali should avoid forcing one.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax jumps in with Jax E Counter Strike active, do not group up nearby. Wait for the area stun to end. After your team starts the fight and draws enemy attention and crowd control, use Akali's mobility to reach the backline and target a vulnerable enemy.

KSante.watch: If K'Sante has hit you with consecutive uses of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes or built stacks by hitting minions, back out of range of the next Q's pull and stun. When K'Sante starts charging K'Sante W Path Maker, save your damage until its unstoppable effect and damage reduction end, and dodge to the side of his charge. When facing him, avoid standing with terrain behind you so K'Sante R All Out cannot knock you over a wall.
KSante.build: Early on, survive with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. K'Sante deals mostly physical damage, so build armor before magic resistance.
KSante.fight: Use the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow K'Sante and create a passive ring. Step back across the ring, then return with the increased range of an empowered basic attack. Do not commit your damage while K'Sante W Path Maker is charging and reducing damage; dodge sideways. When K'Sante R All Out lowers his armor and magic resistance, focus your damage, but do not fight him alone for long: his damage and healing from damage are also increased.
KSante.laning: Afterward, build a health advantage with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks, even if you miss some CS. Once ahead, push the wave and move to another lane.
KSante.combo: For a short trade, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then finish with an empowered basic attack.
KSante.escape: Do not engage just because K'Sante W Path Maker is down. Check whether K'Sante E Footwork and K'Sante R All Out are still available. In particular, before K'Sante R All Out comes back, use Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution to close the gap when his dangerous stacked K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes and K'Sante W Path Maker are down.
KSante.phase: After Akali completes a core ability power item, she can pick off backline targets. K'Sante's Q grows stronger as he builds defensive items, so carry your lane advantage elsewhere.
KSante.teamfight: Do not start the teamfight as Akali. Let your team engage, then target a vulnerable backline enemy after K'Sante's crowd control is spent. During K'Sante R All Out, he becomes less durable, but his damage and healing from damage increase; avoid a fight where several teammates take his hits for a long time. If the fight will last, at least one teammate should have a way to reduce healing.

Karma.watch: Repeated hits from Karma Q Inner Flame let Karma use Karma R Mantra more often through Karma P Gathering Fire. Move behind minions or out of range. If Karma R Mantra empowers her Q and its burning area hits you, leave the circle before it explodes. While Karma W Focused Resolve is connected, use the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip to create distance and avoid the root.
Karma.build: Build magic resistance first against Karma's main damage. If Karma W Focused Resolve often roots you right after you engage, fit Quicksilver Sash between core items. If the healing from Karma R Mantra empowered W prevents a kill, get Morellonomicon for healing reduction.
Karma.fight: After Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma R Mantra empowered E ends, close the gap with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Karma.laning: Move between positions behind minions and outside Karma Q Inner Flame's range to avoid taking free hits. Build a health advantage with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks, even if you miss some CS. Once ahead, push the wave and move to another lane.
Karma.combo: For a short trade, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Karma.escape: After Karma W Focused Resolve is down, Akali has an opening to engage. If the shield from Karma R Mantra empowered E is active, wait for it to expire, then close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution. If Karma W Focused Resolve is already connected to you, create distance before the root lands.
Karma.phase: After completing a core ability power item, you can pick off backline targets. Choose your moment to engage, because failing to finish a target remains dangerous in the late game.
Karma.teamfight: Do not start the teamfight as Akali. Let your team engage, then enter the backline after Karma W Focused Resolve is down. If Karma R Mantra empowered E shields nearby allies, wait for the shields to expire.

Kassadin.watch: The shield from Kassadin Q Null Sphere absorbs the magic damage from Akali Q Five Point Strike, so harass him while Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down. A slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse makes it harder to cross your passive ring; look for an empowered basic attack after Kassadin E Force Pulse has been used.
Kassadin.build: Complete a core ability power item first to improve Akali's ability to secure kills. Build magic resistance over armor against Kassadin's damage.
Kassadin.fight: Hit with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Kassadin and create a passive ring. Step back across the ring, then return with the increased range of an empowered basic attack. Focus your damage when the shield from Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down. If Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, close the gap and fight with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Kassadin.laning: Afterward, build a health advantage with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks. Avoid using unnecessary abilities near Kassadin so that you do not let him use Kassadin E Force Pulse again sooner.
Kassadin.combo: When Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike. Cross its edge, then land an empowered basic attack.
Kassadin.escape: While Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, Akali has an opening to engage.
Kassadin.phase: Late in the game, Kassadin R Riftwalk lets him engage and escape, so do not stand alone within its range.
Kassadin.teamfight: After your team starts the fight, draws enemy attention, and baits out their crowd control, enter the backline as Akali and pick off a vulnerable target. Do not stand alone within range of Kassadin R Riftwalk. If you target Kassadin, wait until his R is down or he is low on mana.

Kennen.watch: Three stacks of Kennen P Mark of the Storm stun you, so back off at two stacks and wait for them to expire. Block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken by standing behind minions, and do not stand on top of allies when Kennen enters with R Slicing Maelstrom.
Kennen.build: Build magic resistance before armor against Kennen's damage. Then complete a core ability power item to gain kill pressure, and consider Quicksilver Sash if you need a way to cleanse his area stun.
Kennen.fight: Close in when Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and his Kennen P Mark of the Storm stacks have expired. Hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow him and create the passive ring, then cross the ring and return with an empowered basic attack.
Kennen.laning: Step out briefly only to last-hit. Build a health advantage with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks, then push the wave and move to another lane.
Kennen.combo: When Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, create the ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross it while backing away, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Kennen.escape: Enter during the window when Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and his Kennen P Mark of the Storm stacks have expired. Use Akali W Twilight Shroud for movement speed and stealth, and close the gap with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Kennen.phase: Once you complete a core ability power item, target the backline, but account for the risk of failing to finish the kill before entering.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out from allies to avoid the area stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, and keep vision of where Kennen may enter. Enter the backline after your allies initiate and the enemy has used its crowd control. Kennen gains resistances during Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom, so do not force a kill while it is active.

Kayle.watch: Avoid a direct hit from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which slows and reduces resistances. Kayle W Celestial Blessing heals and grants movement speed, so do not overcommit to a chase immediately after she uses it. Do not pour out damage while Kayle R Divine Judgment is active; finish off the target after the invulnerability ends.
Kayle.build: Complete a core ability power item first to exploit Kayle's low magic resistance. If healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing delays a kill, apply healing reduction with Morellonomicon. Build magic resistance against Kayle's magic damage, but prioritize dodging Kayle Q Radiant Blast.
Kayle.fight: Cross the Akali P Assassin's Mark ring created by Akali Q Five Point Strike, then return with an empowered basic attack to build a health advantage.
Kayle.laning: Once you have an advantage, push the wave and move to another lane to extend it.
Kayle.combo: Start short trades with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross the Akali P Assassin's Mark ring while backing away, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility ability, so a missed Kayle Q Radiant Blast or a used Kayle W Celestial Blessing creates an opening. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is also down, close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Kayle.teamfight: Do not start teamfights. Wait for your allies to initiate, draw the enemy's attention, and bait out their crowd control. Find a path from the flank or out of vision that leads directly to Kayle, and enter when your allies' crowd control lands. Do not use your finishing damage into the invulnerability from Kayle R Divine Judgment; attack after it ends.

Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, create distance immediately while Kled is still close, before it pulls you in. The fourth basic attack from Kled W Violent Tendencies deals damage based on maximum health, so do not stay close enough to take all four hits. Once dismounted Kled's Courage fills, Skaarl returns with restored health; keep your distance if you cannot finish him off.
Kled.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Kled's main damage is physical and Akali has low armor, so build armor first.
Kled.fight: Back off when Kled W Violent Tendencies activates, then close in again. Enter after Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are down.
Kled.laning: Even if you give up some farm, build a health advantage with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks. After dismounting Kled, push him out of the lane so he cannot build courage by killing minions. If you have built a health advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Kled.combo: Create the passive ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike and back across its edge, then return and hit with the empowered basic attack's increased range.
Kled.escape: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, use a mobility ability such as Akali E Shuriken Flip to create distance before the pull triggers. Do not treat Kled E Jousting being down alone as an opening; wait until Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is also unavailable. Then close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Kled.phase: Kled becomes much weaker after the laning phase and mid game, so a longer game increasingly favors Akali.
Kled.teamfight: Keep vision on the flanks because Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can arrive from far away. If you cannot stop it, put a tank in front and hold your formation, using the fact that it charges only the first enemy champion in its path. Akali does not start the teamfight; she enters the backline after her allies initiate, draw the enemy's attention, and bait out their crowd control.

Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard passes through minions it hits, so avoid standing in line with your minions. If Lissandra casts R Frozen Tomb on herself, she becomes immune to damage; finish her after the stasis ends.
Lissandra.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Lissandra’s main damage. Being caught by Lissandra W Ring of Frost and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is dangerous, so fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items. If she survives through the healing from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, apply healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
Lissandra.fight: Right after Lissandra uses W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it, poke with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike, then cross the passive ring’s edge and trade with an empowered basic attack. After Lissandra uses E Glacial Path, you can close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is still available, spread out your damage until her stasis ends.
Lissandra.laning: Farm from an angle that keeps you out of the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard after it passes through allied minions. Once Akali Q Five Point Strike has gained levels, use its tip and empowered basic attacks to build a health lead, then push the wave and roam to another lane.
Lissandra.combo: For a light trade, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack. If the self-stasis from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb remains, save your finishing damage until the stasis ends.
Lissandra.escape: The moment after you force Lissandra E Glacial Path is your opening to engage. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down, close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Lissandra.phase: Once you complete one core ability power item, you can pick off backliners, but failing to finish them remains dangerous even late in the game, so choose your entry timing.
Lissandra.teamfight: Do not start teamfights as Akali. Wait for your team to engage, draw the enemy's attention, and bait out their crowd control. Check whether Lissandra W Ring of Frost, Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, and Lissandra E Glacial Path have been fully spent before diving the backline. If Lissandra casts R Frozen Tomb on herself, save your damage and finish her when the stasis ends.

Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding catches you, her other abilities can hit you in succession, so bait out and dodge her Q first. It binds the first two targets it hits, even if you stand behind an ally, so do not line up with them. When you see the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark, dodge sideways.
Lux.build: Build magic resistance against Lux’s damage. Lux Q Light Binding can root you as soon as you engage, so fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items to give yourself a way to break free.
Lux.fight: Bait out and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, then close the gap with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution. For a short trade, create a passive ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Lux.laning: If one of Lux’s abilities hits you, back away so her basic attack cannot hit you while Lux P Illumination is on you. Once you have a health lead, push the wave and roam to another lane.
Lux.combo: If Akali E Shuriken Flip hits, cross the passive ring’s edge and land an empowered basic attack. Then recast E to close in again and follow up with another empowered basic attack.
Lux.escape: Right after Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to engage. Lux has no ability to create distance on her own and no mobility ability, so close the gap with the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution. Before recasting Akali E Shuriken Flip, check whether Lux has moved under her turret or into the enemy team.
Lux.phase: Once you complete one core ability power item, you can pick off a fragile backliner like Lux, but Akali is also at risk if she fails to finish the kill. The provided information is insufficient to determine who has the matchup advantage late in the game.
Lux.teamfight: Wait for your team to start the fight and draw the enemy’s attention and crowd control before engaging on Lux. Spread out from your allies and approach from another direction so Lux E Lucent Singularity does not catch you together. Confirm that Lux Q Light Binding is down, then pick off Lux in the backline.

Leblanc.watch: When LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice marks you, her next ability deals more damage, so back off until the mark expires. LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains roots you after the tether holds; immediately after it hits, use the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud or the dashes from Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution to get out of tether range. When LeBlanc P Mirror Image creates a clone, do not rush your abilities; watch which one actually attacks.
Leblanc.build: LeBlanc’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first and consider a spell shield to interrupt combos that start with LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice. If you are likely to be rooted immediately after engaging by LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or LeBlanc R Mimic, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items.
