Leblanc.fight: For a standard trade, slow with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and create a passive ring, then step back across its edge and return with an empowered basic attack. If LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice marks you, stop trading and back off. It is more reliable to engage after LeBlanc W Distortion’s return window expires or its return has already been used.
Leblanc.laning: From then on, use the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks to build a health lead; you can prioritize those trades even if you miss a little CS. Once ahead, push the wave and roam, but alert your team immediately if LeBlanc disappears from mid vision.
Leblanc.escape: Right after you force LeBlanc W Distortion is a chance to close the gap; engaging is even better once her return is over. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Akali W Twilight Shroud to move quickly or Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution to get out of tether range before the root takes hold.
Leblanc.phase: Once you complete one core ability power item, you can pick off backliners, but the provided information is insufficient to judge which champion has the advantage late in the game.
Leblanc.teamfight: Do not start the fight as Akali. Wait for your team to engage, draw the enemy's attention, and bait out their crowd control. Check whether LeBlanc can use the root from LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or LeBlanc R Mimic before diving the backline.

Malphite.watch: Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash that knocks up multiple targets, so when you cannot see him, do not stand close to your allies near walls or bushes. Right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you, do not start a trade or stay in range for long.
Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, Malphite E Ground Slam, and Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Then build core ability power items for Akali’s main magic damage.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield before you start damaging his actual health. Avoid trading right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, and engage with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution while Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down.
Malphite.laning: From then on, poke briefly with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks from Akali P Assassin's Mark to break Malphite P Granite Shield and build a health lead. Once ahead, push the wave and roam to another lane.
Malphite.combo: Hit with Akali Q Five Point Strike at maximum range to create a ring, then step back across its edge and return with an empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark.
Malphite.escape: In teamfights, confirm that the knockup from Malphite R Unstoppable Force has been used, then close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Malphite.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force cannot knock up several of you. After he uses it and your team starts the fight, enter the backline while the enemy’s attention is diverted and their crowd control has been spent, and pick off a fragile target.

Malzahar.watch: When a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect spreads to a nearby enemy, so do not stand beside it to last-hit. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside its two gates, then engage after avoiding the silence. You cannot break the suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp with Akali W Twilight Shroud or a mobility ability, so do not enter areas without vision alone while his R is available.
Malzahar.build: Build magic resistance first against Malzahar Q Call of the Void, W Void Swarm, and E Malefic Visions. Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar can remove the suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, break it with Akali Q Five Point Strike before committing. For a short trade, hit with the tip of Q to slow him and create a passive ring, step back across the ring, then return with the increased-range empowered attack. After dodging Malzahar Q Call of the Void, use Akali E Shuriken Flip or R Perfect Execution to close the gap when the voidlings from Malzahar W Void Swarm have disappeared.
Malzahar.laning: Back away from minions affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions to avoid the spread. If Malzahar pushes the wave, call your jungler, break his shield, then engage together. If you gain a health advantage, push the wave and take that advantage to another lane.
Malzahar.combo: Break Malzahar P Void Shift first with Akali Q Five Point Strike.
Malzahar.escape: The opening to engage comes after you dodge Malzahar Q Call of the Void and the voidlings from Malzahar W Void Swarm disappear. Malzahar has no mobility ability to create distance, but he can stop your engage with R Nether Grasp. If his R is available, fight where an ally can interrupt its cast.
Malzahar.phase: Malzahar grows stronger as he builds up Malzahar W Void Swarm, so the matchup gets worse over time. Pressure him from the start to limit his growth.
Malzahar.teamfight: Enter the backline after an ally starts the fight and the enemy uses its crowd control. When Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available, do not engage relying only on Akali W Twilight Shroud. Check whether an ally can apply immobilizing crowd control to Malzahar and interrupt his cast.

Mel.watch: Mel W Rebuttal reflects projectiles for a brief moment, so check whether she has used it before throwing Akali Q Five Point Strike or Akali E Shuriken Flip. Mel E Solar Snare roots you if its orb hits you in the center; sidestep it and save Akali's mobility for that moment. If Mel has hit you several times, watch for the execute even if you still have health. After the fight, wait somewhere safe until the stacks expire.
Mel.build: Complete an ability power core item first to exploit Mel's low magic resistance. Build magic resistance rather than armor against her damage. If Mel E Solar Snare often roots you immediately after you engage, fit Quicksilver Sash between core items.
Mel.fight: Step back outside the ring, then return with the increased-range empowered attack to gain a health advantage. If you have baited out Mel W Rebuttal and dodged the root from Mel E Solar Snare, close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Mel.laning: After that, chip away at Mel with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered attacks, even if you miss some CS. Once you have a health advantage, push the wave to limit Mel's growth and move to another lane.
Mel.combo: After Mel W Rebuttal is down, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then land an empowered attack. If Akali E Shuriken Flip hits, cross the ring and land an empowered attack. Check Mel's position before using E's recast to dash to her and land another empowered attack.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility ability, so the opening to engage comes after you dodge the root from Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal is down. Close the gap with the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud and the dashes from Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution. If Mel has retreated under her turret or into the enemy team, check her position before using the recast dash from Akali E Shuriken Flip.
Mel.phase: Once you complete an ability power core item in the mid game, look for chances to pick off Mel. The growth she gains from Mel R Golden Eclipse is permanent, so the matchup gets worse over time. Pressure her early to delay that growth.
Mel.teamfight: Let an ally start the teamfight, then engage after crowd control such as Mel E Solar Snare has been used.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and faster after hitting something, so do not stand in line behind an ally. If a disguised Neeko approaches, the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom may be hidden; create distance early. Do not chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter.
Neeko.build: Build magic resistance first against Neeko's main damage. Prioritize tenacity if getting rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs leads to death from Neeko R Pop Blossom.
Neeko.fight: Early on, dodge Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and take short trades with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered attacks. Once Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, close in with Akali E Shuriken Flip and continue the fight. After engaging, leave the area if you see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom or a disguised Neeko comes close.
Neeko.laning: After that, use Akali Q Five Point Strike to gain a health advantage and make use of empowered attacks even if you miss some farm. Once you have an advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Neeko.combo: Create a passive ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered attack.
Neeko.escape: The moment after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used is your chance to close in.
Neeko.phase: After completing one ability power core item, look for the backline, but keep in mind throughout the fight that you can easily die if you fail to finish your target.
Neeko.teamfight: Let an ally start the teamfight and wait for the enemy's attention and crowd control to be spent. If a disguised Neeko comes close, spread out in anticipation of Neeko R Pop Blossom; leave the area if you see its windup. Then use Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution to enter the backline and pick off a vulnerable target.

Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither reduces movement and attack speed, so do not fight him alone within its range while it is available. Avoid fighting while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, and move out of Nasus E Spirit Fire.
Nasus.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first because Nasus Q Siphoning Strike is his main damage, but remember that armor does not protect you from Nasus E Spirit Fire or Nasus R Fury of the Sands.
Nasus.laning: Pressure Nasus from the early game so he cannot freely last-hit and stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Do not push the wave under his turret. Let him come toward your side and call for a jungle gank.
Nasus.combo: Create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then return with the empowered attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark.
Nasus.escape: Nasus has no mobility ability of his own, so engage when Nasus W Wither is down and Nasus R Fury of the Sands is inactive. Close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution, but check whether he has gone under his turret before recasting Akali E Shuriken Flip.
Nasus.teamfight: Let an ally start the teamfight, then enter the backline after the enemy's attention and crowd control have been spent. Do not fight Nasus head-on while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active; keep your distance and wait out its duration.

Naafiri.watch: If the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers lands, keep your distance until the bleed ends to avoid the second hit. Naafiri's pack respawns right after Naafiri E Eviscerate, so check whether she has used it before clearing the pack. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she cannot be targeted; use your finishing ability after it ends.
Naafiri.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first. If healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate prolongs the duel, build resistances before getting Morellonomicon for healing reduction.
Naafiri.fight: Avoid forced fights early and poke with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike. Step outside the passive ring to ready an empowered basic attack, then return to hit her for a short trade. Go in after Naafiri has used several mobility abilities and Naafiri W The Call of the Pack has ended.
Naafiri.laning: Even if you give up some farm, use the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks to gain a health advantage. Once ahead, push the wave and move to another lane, but maintain broad vision to prepare for Naafiri's midgame roams.
Naafiri.combo: For a standard trade, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Naafiri.escape: If Naafiri has used only one of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or Naafiri E Eviscerate, she can escape with the remaining mobility ability, so do not rush in. Look especially for the window before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back up, after her other mobility ability and Naafiri W The Call of the Pack have also been used. Close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Naafiri.phase: Naafiri's roams are most dangerous in the midgame, so maintain broad vision. In late-game frontal teamfights, area damage wipes out her pack and reduces her damage, so stay grouped with your team when fighting.
Naafiri.teamfight: After your team engages and draws out the enemy's attention and crowd control, target a vulnerable backliner. If Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is available, do not travel alone. Immediately retreat after an ally dies so you are not picked off next.

Mordekaiser.watch: If Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp pulls you in, Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and basic attacks can follow, so keep your distance when facing him. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after he lands three hits, so trade briefly and back off. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, do not enter its range expecting help from allies.
Mordekaiser.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, and Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. If healing from Mordekaiser W Indestructible lets him survive fights, get Morellonomicon for healing reduction. Since Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise scales with maximum health, avoid building only a large amount of health.
Mordekaiser.fight: Before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates, trade briefly with Akali Q Five Point Strike and an empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark, then back off. Do not commit your damage right after the shield from Mordekaiser W Indestructible activates; focus him once the shield has worn down or been converted into healing. After Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is used, look for a chance to close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Mordekaiser.laning: Step back outside the ring created by Akali Q Five Point Strike, land an empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark, then create distance again so Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise does not activate. Once you have a health advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Mordekaiser.combo: For a short trade, use Akali Q Five Point Strike, step outside the ring, then land an empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark.
Mordekaiser.escape: Mordekaiser has no mobility ability, so the window to go in is after Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is used. If Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, first judge whether you can duel him without help from allies.
Mordekaiser.phase: Even in the mid-to-late game, failing to finish Mordekaiser is dangerous. Check the shield from Mordekaiser W Indestructible and Mordekaiser R Realm of Death before going in.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Let your team engage first, then target the backline after the enemy's attention and crowd control have been drawn out. Keep some space between you and your allies so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp cannot pull in several of you at once. Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can separate you from your team, so do not set up your approach within his range.

Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow lowers Akali's armor and slows her. Dodge the axe as it flies, then move in the opposite direction from where it lands to make it harder for him to retrieve. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that armor cannot reduce, so when health is low, create distance with Akali W Twilight Shroud and mobility abilities. When Olaf R Ragnarok activates, his movement speed and defenses increase; avoid fighting him and wait for it to end.
Olaf.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Olaf deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first, but remember that armor cannot reduce the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Olaf.fight: Hit Olaf with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow him and create a passive ring. Back away across the ring, then use the increased range of your empowered basic attack for a short trade. Olaf gains attack speed and lifesteal as his health falls, so do not stay in a long fight even when he reaches half health. Once Olaf R Ragnarok ends and you have lowered his health enough, look to finish him with Akali R Perfect Execution.
Olaf.laning: Move in the opposite direction from where the axe from Olaf Q Undertow lands to prevent him from retrieving it. Use the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks to gain a health advantage. Even if you miss some farm, establish that advantage before pushing the wave and moving to another lane.
Olaf.combo: For a standard trade, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Olaf.phase: Olaf becomes relatively weaker as the game goes late, while Akali can pick off backliners once she completes her core ability power items.
Olaf.teamfight: Do not start teamfights as Akali. Wait for your team to engage and draw out the enemy's attention and crowd control. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance instead of continuing to fight him, then use Akali's mobility to reach the backline and pick off a vulnerable target.
Olaf.escape: A brief opening appears after Olaf Q Undertow is thrown when a shift in position makes the axe difficult to retrieve. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, use the stealth and movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud and the mobility of Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution to create distance and wait it out. Afterward, look for another opening to go in, since Olaf has no ability to create distance himself.

Orianna.watch: Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in near the spot where Orianna Q Command: Attack places the ball, so watch the ball when positioning. The slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and the shield from Orianna E Command: Protect also hinder your engage, so do not fight for long where the ball is placed.
Orianna.build: On your first purchase, first consider movement speed to help you leave the area Orianna telegraphs. If you build a resistance, choose magic resistance against her empowered basic attacks and main ability damage.
Orianna.fight: Right after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her, she loses the sustained defensive stats from Orianna E Command: Protect, so take a trade. Hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow her and create a ring, step across its edge, then return within empowered basic attack range and hit her.
Orianna.laning: As Akali Q Five Point Strike gains ranks, use its edge hit and empowered basic attacks to build a health advantage. Press that advantage even if you miss a little farm. Once ahead, push the wave and roam to another lane.
Orianna.combo: When Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her, land Akali E Shuriken Flip, cross the ring's edge and land an empowered basic attack, then recast Akali E Shuriken Flip to close in again and follow up with another empowered basic attack.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no ability to create distance herself, so go in during the window after Orianna R Command: Shockwave is used and the ball is away from her. Close the gap with the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud and the dash from Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution. Before recasting Akali E Shuriken Flip, check whether the marked target is under a turret or among the enemy team.
Orianna.phase: After completing one core ability power item, target the backline, but keep in mind throughout that failing to finish your target is dangerous.
Orianna.teamfight: Let your team engage first and wait for the enemy's attention and crowd control to be drawn out. Check Orianna R Command: Shockwave and the ball's position, then use Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution to reach the backline and pick off a vulnerable target.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns you, so keep your distance before entering its range. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the direction he faces; wait for it to end or move to his side instead of attacking from the front. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its area.
Pantheon.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Pantheon's main damage is physical, and Akali has low armor, so build armor first.
Pantheon.fight: Poke with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Pantheon and create a passive ring. Back away outside the ring, then return with an empowered basic attack. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, stop attacking from the front and wait for it to end or change your angle.
Pantheon.laning: Keep minions between you and Pantheon Q Comet Spear to reduce the damage it deals to targets behind them. Early on, give up some CS if needed to survive without giving up a kill. Look for a health advantage with Akali Q Five Point Strike poke and empowered basic attacks. Once you have the advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Pantheon.combo: For a short trade, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Pantheon.escape: Your opening to engage is after Pantheon W Shield Vault has been used and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available again. Close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution. If only one of Pantheon's mobility options has been used, he can escape with the other, so do not rush the engage.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's impact falls off later, so it is important to avoid giving up kills early and buy time.
Pantheon.teamfight: Do not start teamfights as Akali. Wait for your team to engage and draw the enemy’s attention and crowd control. Check especially that Pantheon W Shield Vault has been used, then enter the backline and target a squishy enemy.

Qiyana.watch: If Qiyana approaches holding the river element, back out of the root range of Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. If she disappears while holding the brush element, move into your team's vision to prepare for an ambush. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes and stuns when it hits a wall, so keep walls away from your back and avoid riversides and narrow passages.
Qiyana.build: Qiyana's main damage is physical, and Akali has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps. If Qiyana's root and stun make it likely you will be locked down after engaging, buy Quicksilver Sash between core items.
Qiyana.fight: Counterattack right after Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity have been used. For a short trade, hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to create a ring, step back across it, then return with an empowered basic attack. Use Akali W Twilight Shroud just before engaging or to interrupt an enemy targeted ability.
Qiyana.laning: As Akali Q Five Point Strike gains levels, use its tip and empowered basic attacks to build a health advantage. Look for favorable trades even if you miss some farm. Once you have a health advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Qiyana.escape: If only Qiyana W Terrashape has been used, she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity, so do not rush the engage. Close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution before Qiyana E Audacity is available again, when her root and stun have also been used.
Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so avoid giving her an advantage in the early and mid game and build armor. She becomes relatively weaker later. Stay with your team, but position away from terrain so Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent cannot hit several of you.
Qiyana.teamfight: Let your team start the fight. After Qiyana's crowd control has been spent, enter the backline as Akali and pick off a squishy target.

Poppy.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Poppy's main damage is physical, and Akali has low armor, so build armor first. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building a large amount of health alone.
Poppy.fight: Hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Poppy and create a passive ring. Step back across the ring, then trade with an empowered basic attack. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, hold your dash or approach on foot, and engage after it ends. Right after Poppy uses Poppy E Heroic Charge, you can use the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud to close the gap.
Poppy.laning: Stay in the open with no wall behind you, and build a health advantage with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks. When the shield from Poppy P Iron Ambassador drops, step on it first to deny her the shield. Once you have a health advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then land an empowered basic attack.
Poppy.phase: Early on, Akali lacks armor and energy, so do not rush trades against Poppy. Once you complete one ability power core item, you can pick off the backline. Choose your target carefully even later, because failing to finish the kill is dangerous.
Poppy.escape: The moment after you make Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge is your opening to close the distance. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is still active, wait before dashing with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution. If Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict is also down, engage while the risk of forced movement is lower.
Poppy.teamfight: Let your allies start the fight, then target a squishy backline opponent after the enemy’s crowd control has been used. Before engaging, check whether Poppy W Steadfast Presence and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict are available; delay your engage if your dash would be stopped or you would be knocked back.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, dashing near her with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution gets stopped, and you can’t use mobility abilities briefly. Stand in an open area, since Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if your back is to a wall. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you, leave the zone before its second hit detonates. If you see Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict charging, move sideways out of its path.

Ornn.watch: The pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture also counts as a wall, so stay away from it and terrain walls. When Ornn prepares Ornn E Searing Charge, use Akali E Shuriken Flip to move toward open ground and avoid the knockup. If the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, keep your distance until it wears off.
Ornn.build: The available information does not determine which item to buy first. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so stacking only one type of resistance will not protect you from all of them. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about building a large amount of health alone.
Ornn.fight: Hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Ornn and create a passive ring. Step back across the ring, then return with an empowered basic attack. Do not chase too far before Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God have been used. Close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali E Shuriken Flip while both are unavailable.
Ornn.laning: As Akali Q Five Point Strike gains levels, use hits with its tip and empowered basic attacks to build a health advantage. Prioritize that advantage even if you miss some CS. If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane, get close and interrupt the crafting. Once you have an advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Ornn.combo: Start with a trade that creates a passive ring using Akali Q Five Point Strike, steps back across it, then returns with an empowered basic attack.
Ornn.escape: If only Ornn E Searing Charge has been used, Ornn can escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God, so do not rush the engage. When Ornn R Call of the Forge God is unavailable and Ornn E Searing Charge has also been used, close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Ornn.phase: Apply pressure and aim to end the game before Ornn builds up items and masterwork upgrades for his team.
Ornn.teamfight: Do not start teamfights as Akali. Enter the backline after your team engages and draws the enemy’s attention and crowd control. Sidestep the elemental summoned by Ornn R Call of the Forge God, and stay clear of both the line between it and Ornn and its return path.

Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, back out of Quinn's basic attack range before she lands the empowered attack. Dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind your minion wave so it hits a minion first. Quinn E Vault knocks back and slows Akali's engage, so do not force your way in until she uses it.
Quinn.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to withstand Quinn's physical damage early. Choose Plated Steelcaps and prioritize armor.
Quinn.fight: Early on, preserve your health instead of engaging first because of the range difference. Trade when Quinn E Vault is down or your jungler arrives. Hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow her and create a passive ring, then cross the ring and return within empowered basic attack range.
Quinn.laning: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, back off and let the mark expire. Farm when you are unmarked.
Quinn.combo: After Quinn E Vault is down, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross its edge, and return with an empowered basic attack.
Quinn.escape: The moment Quinn E Vault is down is Akali's opening to engage. Use the stealth and movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud, then close the gap with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Quinn.phase: Early on, Akali must preserve her health and endure Quinn's range advantage. Later, watch for Quinn's roams and target the backline once Akali completes a core ability power item.
Quinn.teamfight: After your team starts the fight and the enemy uses its crowd control, enter the backline with Akali W Twilight Shroud and movement abilities. If Quinn comes in from the flank, look for a chance to lock her down with your team’s crowd control.

Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger's fury bar is above or just below half, watch for the stun from an empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator and stay out of range. Renekton E Slice and Dice grants a second dash if the first hits a unit, so do not stand in or behind a minion wave.
Renekton.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Renekton deals mainly physical damage, and Akali has low armor, so build armor first. If healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek prevents a kill, buy Morellonomicon for healing reduction.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton P Reign of Anger's fury bar is empty or after Renekton uses his first combo. Hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow him and create a ring, retreat across it, then return with the empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark.
Renekton.laning: Poke Renekton when he steps up to hit minions for fury. Once you gain a health advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Renekton.combo: For a standard trade, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, retreat across it, then land the empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark.
Renekton.escape: The moment Renekton disengages with Renekton E Slice and Dice is an opening to engage. If the stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator is also down, close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Renekton.phase: Renekton's value falls off from mid game onward, so keep scaling and wait for an opening. Target the backline once you complete a core ability power item.
Renekton.teamfight: Let your team engage first, then wait for the enemy’s attention and crowd control to be spent. In particular, confirm that Renekton W Ruthless Predator’s stun is down before diving a vulnerable backline target.

Riven.watch: The third dash of Riven Q Broken Wings knocks you up, and Riven W Ki Burst stuns, so back off when you see the first dash. Riven R Blade of the Exile increases her range, and its remaining Wind Slash is especially dangerous when health has been reduced. Keep your distance until its duration ends.
Riven.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps. Riven deals mostly physical damage, and Akali has low armor, so build armor first.
Riven.fight: When Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings on minions, poke with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike. Retreat across the passive ring, then return with the extended-range empowered basic attack. Check Riven's remaining mobility abilities before engaging.
Riven.laning: After leveling Akali Q Five Point Strike, give up a little farm if needed to gain a health advantage with its tip and empowered basic attacks. Once ahead, push the wave and move to another lane.
Riven.combo: While Riven Q Broken Wings is down, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, retreat across its edge, then land an empowered basic attack.
Riven.escape: Don’t go in just because Riven Q Broken Wings is down; check Riven E Valor too. Close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, E Shuriken Flip, and R Perfect Execution while Riven W Ki Burst’s stun is also down, especially before Riven Q comes off cooldown.
Riven.phase: Once you complete one core ability power item, you can pick off backline targets, but failing to finish a target remains dangerous even late in the game.
Riven.teamfight: Engage after your team starts the fight and Riven has used the knockup from Riven Q Broken Wings and the stun from Riven W Ki Burst.

Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on maximum health in a close-range cone, so do not stay near him for long. If the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits you, use Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution to create distance before the second shot arrives while you are slowed and have reduced magic resistance. Watch for the slow from Rumble R The Equalizer too.
Rumble.build: Completing a core ability power item improves Akali's ability to kill backline targets. If you need a defensive item, choose one with magic resistance against Rumble's magic damage. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only a large amount of health.
Rumble.fight: When Rumble walks forward to land Rumble Q Flamespitter, poke with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross the passive ring, land an empowered basic attack, then retreat. If Rumble activates Rumble W Scrap Shield, save your burst damage until the shield disappears. After he has used Rumble W Scrap Shield, look for a chance to engage with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Rumble.laning: After leveling Akali Q Five Point Strike, give up a little farm if needed to gain a health advantage with its tip and empowered basic attacks. Once ahead, push the wave and move to another lane.
Rumble.combo: For a short trade, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, retreat across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack. When engaging, land the first hit of Akali E Shuriken Flip, cross the ring and land an empowered basic attack, then use the second dash to close in and land another. When you have a chance to kill, close in with the first cast of Akali R Perfect Execution, lower the target's health with Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks, then use the second cast of Akali R Perfect Execution last for its damage based on missing health.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability, so the opening to engage comes after the movement speed boost from Rumble W Scrap Shield is also down. If the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits you, escape with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution before the second shot. The recast of Akali E Shuriken Flip follows the marked target all the way, so check Rumble's position before using it if he has retreated under a turret or into the enemy team.
Rumble.phase: After completing a core ability power item, you can target the backline, but the given information is insufficient to determine which champion is stronger late in the game.
Rumble.teamfight: Do not start the teamfight as Akali. Wait for your team to engage and draw the enemy's attention and crowd control. Then enter the backline with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution and pick off a vulnerable target. Failing to finish the target is dangerous, so use the second cast of Akali R Perfect Execution after lowering the target's health.

Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, move away from allies and keep your distance until the mark disappears. While marked, Ryze W Rune Prison roots you and Ryze Q Overload deals increased damage, so dodge Ryze E Spell Flux first. If you see Ryze R Realm Warp, anticipate the arrival location it will lead to after activation.
Ryze.build: Ryze deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first.
Ryze.fight: Hit with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Ryze, cross the passive ring, then return for an empowered basic attack. After dodging Ryze E Spell Flux or once Ryze W Rune Prison is down, use Akali W Twilight Shroud to close the gap and Akali E Shuriken Flip to reach him.
Ryze.laning: As Akali Q Five Point Strike ranks up, use its outer edge and empowered basic attacks to gain a health advantage, and pressure Ryze before he gets his items. Once you have gained a health advantage, even if you missed some farm to do so, push the wave and move to another lane.
Ryze.combo: Create a passive ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Ryze.escape: If both Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison are down, the risk of being rooted is lower. Close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Ryze.phase: A failed finish is still dangerous, so check whether Ryze can root you before going in.
Ryze.teamfight: Go in after your team starts the fight and the enemy has spent their attention and crowd control. Check that the root from Ryze E Spell Flux and Ryze W Rune Prison is down, then use Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution to reach the backline and pick off a squishy target.

Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker grows stronger after he takes damage, so back away right after dealing heavy damage and sidestep its center line when he fires. Sett E Facebreaker stuns if it catches targets on both sides, so avoid being caught opposite a minion wave with Sett between you. Sett R The Show Stopper suppresses you if it catches you, so choose your entry point carefully while he has his ultimate.
Sett.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Sett deals mostly physical damage and Akali has low armor, so build armor first. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on maximum health, and resistances do not reduce the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker, so do not rely on stacking health alone to survive.
Sett.fight: If you deal enough damage to make Sett W Haymaker strong, back off briefly and reengage after his Grit falls. Go in while Sett E Facebreaker is down or Sett R The Show Stopper is unavailable.
Sett.laning: Hit with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Sett and create a passive ring. Retreat outside the ring, then return to empowered basic attack range to harass him. Early on, focus on gaining a health advantage even if you miss some farm. Once ahead, push the wave and roam.
Sett.combo: For a basic trade, use Akali Q Five Point Strike, retreat outside the ring, then land an empowered basic attack.
Sett.escape: Once Sett E Facebreaker is down, you have an opening to go in with less risk of being stunned.
Sett.phase: Once you complete one core ability power item, you can pick off backline targets, but a failed finish is dangerous. The provided material does not establish who has the matchup advantage later in the game.
Sett.teamfight: Do not start teamfights as Akali. Wait for your team to engage and for the enemy to spend their attention and crowd control. Watch for Sett E Facebreaker and Sett R The Show Stopper, then target a squishy backliner. When Sett uses Sett W Haymaker, use Akali's mobility to sidestep its center line.

Shen.watch: Shen E Shadow Dash taunts you, making it easy for him to hit you with basic attacks empowered by Shen Q Twilight Assault. Dodge his dash with Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip, and move out of the sword's path as it returns to Shen. If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, wait before using your empowered basic attack.
Shen.build: Consider tenacity first against the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage and Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so do not build only one type of resistance. Avoid relying on health alone because of the damage based on maximum health.
Shen.fight: Use the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Shen and create a passive ring, then cross its boundary and return for a short trade with an empowered basic attack. If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, move with Akali W Twilight Shroud and close the gap with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution. Do not rush your empowered basic attack while Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active.
Shen.laning: Then push the lane to keep Shen occupied with CS. If he leaves with Shen R Stand United, take advantage of the empty lane.
Shen.combo: After Shen E Shadow Dash misses, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Shen.escape: Right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your chance to go in. If Shen R Stand United is also still on cooldown, close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Shen.phase: Once you complete one core ability power item, look for the backline, but account for the risk of failing to finish your target and watch for Shen joining with Shen R Stand United.
Shen.teamfight: Enter the backline after your team starts the fight and crowd control such as Shen E Shadow Dash is down. If you see Shen channeling Shen R Stand United or he disappears from lane, tell your team and judge whether you can finish the fight before he arrives.

Sion.watch: When Sion charges Sion Q Decimating Smash, move sideways instead of backing away. Sidestep the straight path of Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Dodging Sion E Roar of the Slayer matters because it reduces your armor if it hits. When Sion rises again through Sion P Glory in Death, create distance and reposition instead of fighting where you are.
Sion.build: Early on, use Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Sion deals mostly physical damage and Akali has low armor, so build armor first. Damage from Sion P Glory in Death scales with maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Sion.fight: Step back across the ring's boundary, then return to hit with the empowered basic attack's increased range. When Sion W Soul Furnace is active, look for a chance to focus damage on the shield and break it before it detonates.
Sion.laning: Use the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks to gain a health advantage, even if it costs you some farm. Once ahead, push the wave to disrupt Sion's farming or roam to gain an advantage elsewhere. Sion permanently gains maximum health as he kills units, so do not let him farm freely.
Sion.combo: Create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, retreat beyond its boundary, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Sion.escape: Force Sion to end the charge of Sion Q Decimating Smash early or dodge it sideways, then close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Sion.phase: Sion's maximum health grows over time, so in the mid to late game, disrupt his farming or gain an advantage in another lane instead of leaving him alone.
Sion.teamfight: Do not start teamfights as Akali. Go in after your team engages and the enemy has spent their attention and crowd control. Avoid the paths of Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught, then target a squishy backliner. If Sion falls, create distance and reposition until Sion P Glory in Death ends.

Singed.watch: You cannot use movement abilities on Singed W Mega Adhesive, so go around it. If Singed E Fling hits you on it, you will be rooted; keep your distance especially when enemies are behind Singed. Even if Singed is low on health, do not chase him through Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.build: After passing through the phase when Akali Q Five Point Strike poke gains strength, build your core ability power items, but add magic resistance if you need to survive Singed. Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling both deal magic damage, and Singed E Fling also scales with maximum health, so do not stack only health. If the root traps you after you engage, fit Quicksilver Sash between core items.
Singed.fight: Avoid forced trades early. Hit with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Singed and create the passive ring, then step back and return with an empowered basic attack. Go around Singed W Mega Adhesive and engage when Singed E Fling is down. If Singed flees while leaving Singed Q Poison Trail behind, chase only when you are sure you can finish him.
Singed.laning: As you level Akali Q Five Point Strike, use its outer edge and empowered basic attacks to gain a health advantage, giving up a little CS if needed. Once ahead, push the wave and move to another lane.
Singed.combo: Create the ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then land an empowered basic attack.
Singed.escape: Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so go in when Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling are down. When the adhesive is not underfoot, close the gap with the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud and the dash from Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Singed.phase: Singed becomes harder to kill once he has his core items. Instead of chasing him for long, carry your advantage to another lane.
Singed.teamfight: Do not send several teammates chasing Singed. Target his allies while your team holds him down. Akali should enter the backline after the enemy's attention and crowd control have been spent, rather than starting the teamfight. Before going in, check the position of Singed W Mega Adhesive and whether Singed E Fling is available. Do not chase deep if you cannot secure the kill.

Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere lies between Syndra and Akali, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can push it into you and stun you, so move out of its path. Walk out of the telegraphed areas of Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Beware of Syndra R Unleashed Power where many spheres are on the ground.
Syndra.build: Buy boots early for the movement speed to dodge Syndra's skillshots. Build magic resistance against abilities such as Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak, and add health to withstand the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power, which resistance cannot prevent.
Syndra.fight: Right after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is used, close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, or Akali R Perfect Execution. For short trades, hit with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross the passive ring, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Syndra.laning: Even if you miss a little farm, use the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks to gain a health advantage. Once ahead, push the wave and move to another lane.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak is Syndra's only self-defense ability. Right after she uses it is your chance to go in.
Syndra.phase: If Syndra's ability effects change later, assume an upgrade has changed their power or range and adjust your spacing.
Syndra.teamfight: Let your team initiate, then enter the backline after crowd control, including Syndra E Scatter the Weak, has been spent. Syndra R Unleashed Power is dangerous where several Syndra Q Dark Spheres are on the ground, so reposition or go in only if you can withstand its damage.

Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact charges through terrain and stuns you if it collides with a wall, so do not stand with your back to one. If you allow a wall collision, back off with his next charge in mind. You cannot escape the suppression from Skarner R Impale with Akali's movement abilities, so be especially careful when Skarner gets close.
Skarner.fight: Stay outside the range of Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval's empowered basic attacks and poke with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike. Cross the ring from Akali P Assassin's Mark, then return to empowered basic attack range for a short trade. When Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, look for a chance to close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Skarner.laning: After leveling Akali Q Five Point Strike, look to gain a health advantage with outer-edge poke and empowered basic attacks from Akali P Assassin's Mark. Once ahead, push the wave and move to another lane to carry your advantage over.
Skarner.combo: After Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is used, create the ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then return with an empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark.
Skarner.escape: Right after you draw out Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is your opening to engage with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, or Akali R Perfect Execution. If you are within range of Skarner R Impale, choose your entry position carefully: Akali's movement abilities cannot break its suppression.
Skarner.phase: Once you complete your core ability power items, you can kill backline targets, but failing to finish them is dangerous. Skarner gains both damage and durability as he builds tank items, so use early initiative and objectives to delay that point.
Skarner.build: Decide in advance whether to build Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to counter the suppression from Skarner R Impale. If you build resistance, prioritize magic resistance against the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval deal damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone.

Sylas.watch: The follow-up chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is more dangerous than its first dash. If the chain hits, Sylas pulls himself to you and knocks you up, so time a movement ability such as Akali E Shuriken Flip to dodge the chain. The intersection of Sylas Q Chain Lash explodes after a delay, so move away immediately even if the first hit only grazes you. Sylas W Kingslayer heals more when he has lost more health, so do not delay the finish for long after lowering his health.
Sylas.build: Get Grievous Wounds from Morellonomicon early to counter the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance against Sylas's damage.
Sylas.fight: For basic trades, hit with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike, retreat outside the passive ring, then return with an empowered basic attack. Dodge the chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct; before that ability is available again is your chance to engage. If Sylas W Kingslayer is also down, look to finish him while he has fewer ways to move.
Sylas.laning: After leveling Akali Q Five Point Strike, use its outer edge and empowered basic attacks to gain a health advantage. Keep poking even if it costs you a little farm. Once ahead, push the wave and move to another lane.
Sylas.combo: After the chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is used, create the ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then land an empowered basic attack.
Sylas.escape: Do not engage just because Sylas has used the first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Wait until the follow-up chain is used. Sylas W Kingslayer also lets him move, so look for a window when both abilities are down if possible.
Sylas.phase: The given information does not establish who has the advantage late game, so base your teamfight decisions on when you can engage and whether you can secure the kill.
Sylas.teamfight: Akali should let her team initiate, then enter the backline after the enemy's attention and crowd control have been spent. Right after Sylas engages with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is a chance for your team to focus crowd control and attacks on him before he heals with Sylas W Kingslayer. Sylas R Hijack can steal Akali's ultimate, so watch for situations where you give him the range to steal it.

TahmKench.watch: When Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste reaches two stacks, back off until they expire. Allowing a third basic attack or Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash gives him an opening to stun you and use Tahm Kench R Devour. When you see the animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, move away from its landing point to avoid the area knockup.
TahmKench.build: The main damage from Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is magic, so build magic resistance first. If fights drag on because of the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin, buy Morellonomicon for healing reduction.
TahmKench.fight: When Tahm Kench has no stacks, hit with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to create a ring. Back out across its boundary, then return with an empowered basic attack. Tahm Kench E Thick Skin can turn damage into healing or a shield, so avoid long trades that cannot secure a kill. Whittle down his health, then burst him at once.
TahmKench.laning: As Akali Q Five Point Strike gains ranks, use hits at the edge of its range and empowered autos to build a health lead. Use that lead even if you miss a few CS. Once you have it, push the wave and roam to another lane.
TahmKench.combo: Use Akali Q Five Point Strike to create a ring, back out across its boundary, then return with an empowered basic attack.
TahmKench.escape: After Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is used, he has a harder time engaging or escaping. Look for a chance to close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
TahmKench.phase: A failed finish is still dangerous, so account for Tahm Kench's healing and shield before going in.
TahmKench.teamfight: After your team starts the fight and draws out the enemy's attention and crowd control, target a vulnerable backline champion. Focus your damage on the carry Tahm Kench is protecting rather than trying to kill him first, but account for Tahm Kench R Devour: if it is available, he can swallow your target and prevent the finish. If he swallows the target, keep up the pressure with the area damage from Akali Q Five Point Strike or Akali R Perfect Execution.

Talon.watch: Getting hit by both the outward and returning daggers of Talon W Rake builds stacks of Talon P Blade's End. If the first hit lands, move out of the return path. Do not chase too far while Talon R Shadow Assault is available; he can escape with its stealth.
Talon.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Talon's damage is physical, so build armor first, along with health to account for his flat penetration. If the healing from Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy hinders your engage, buy Morellonomicon for healing reduction.
Talon.fight: Avoid Talon's strong trades early and poke with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike. Right after he uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, or Akali R Perfect Execution. If he has already used Talon R Shadow Assault, look to counterattack.
Talon.laning: Build a health lead with Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks from Akali P Assassin's Mark, even if you miss some farm. Once ahead, push the wave and move, while keeping vision on Talon's roaming route and sharing his location.
Talon.combo: For a short trade, use Akali Q Five Point Strike to create a ring, back out across its boundary, then return and hit with an empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark.
Talon.escape: Right after you draw out Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is your chance to engage. Avoid the return path of Talon W Rake, then close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip.
Talon.phase: In mid game, once Akali completes a core ability power item, look for backline kills. In late game, Talon's impact falls off, so fight as a group.
Talon.teamfight: Do not start the teamfight. Enter the backline after your team engages and draws out the enemy's attention and crowd control. If Talon dives your backline, group with your team and layer crowd control against him.

Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart nullifies basic attacks, so do not attempt an empowered basic attack while blinded. A single basic attack with Teemo E Toxic Shot causes continuing poison damage, so stay out of range unless you are ready to engage. In brush you have no vision of and along key paths, watch for the stealth from Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare and Teemo R Noxious Trap.
Teemo.build: Teemo's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. The source gives no specific item purchase order, so do not commit to a particular item.
Teemo.fight: Once Teemo Q Blinding Dart is used, close the gap and fight with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution. If blinded, deal damage with abilities or back off before using an empowered basic attack.
Teemo.laning: Avoid trades where Teemo hits you with a basic attack and you retreat. Look to gain a health lead with Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks. Even if you lose some farm, do not stand within Teemo's range needlessly. Once you have a health lead, push the wave and move to another lane.
Teemo.combo: Use Akali Q Five Point Strike to create a ring, back out across its boundary, then return the hit with an empowered basic attack.
Teemo.escape: Right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is used is your chance to engage. Teemo W Move Quick increases his movement speed, but he has no other way to create distance. Close the gap with the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud and the dashes from Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Teemo.phase: Afterward, turn your lane lead into pressure elsewhere before Teemo has time to build up traps, while watching for the risk of failing to finish a kill.
Teemo.teamfight: Do not start the teamfight. Enter the backline after your team engages and draws out the enemy's attention and crowd control. Clear Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and in narrow passages with Oracle Lens. When retreating, stay alert even on shortcuts you have already passed through.

Tryndamere.watch: When stacks of Tryndamere P Battle Fury build up, his critical strikes become threatening. Back off when he starts hitting minions to build Fury. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is easier to use again around many minions, so do not chase him there. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, you cannot kill him; stop pouring in damage and create distance.
Tryndamere.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Tryndamere's damage is mostly physical, and Akali's armor is relatively low, so prioritize armor. If the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust makes engaging a losing trade, buy Morellonomicon for healing reduction.
Tryndamere.fight: Close the gap right after you draw out Tryndamere E Spinning Slash. For a short trade, hit with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow him and create a passive ring. Back out across the ring, then return and hit with an empowered basic attack. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is still available, create distance and buy time instead of dealing finishing damage.
Tryndamere.laning: Before Tryndamere can build Fury with last hits, poke with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks. Build a health lead even if you miss some farm, then push the wave and move to another lane.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is used is your window to close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution. When retreating, face Tryndamere as you walk backward to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Tryndamere.phase: Afterward, if Tryndamere R Undying Rage is still ready, do not try to hold the side lane alone. Check whether he has used it and respond accordingly.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Akali should not start the teamfight. After your team engages and draws out the enemy's attention and crowd control, target a vulnerable backline champion. Do not defend a side lane alone while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready. When going to kill him, check whether he has used it or bring more teammates. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, create distance and wait it out before dealing damage again.

Trundle.watch: When Trundle W Frozen Domain is active, don't fight inside it. Use the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud or use Akali E Shuriken Flip to create distance and wait out its duration. Trundle E Pillar of Ice can block your retreat in narrow paths, so fight in open areas and move sideways immediately when the pillar appears. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, he becomes tougher; create distance or attack another target.
Trundle.build: Early on, survive with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Trundle's main damage, including Trundle Q Chomp, is physical, so build armor first. If healing from Trundle P King's Tribute lets him endure fights, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Trundle.fight: Retreat outside Trundle W Frozen Domain, wait out its duration, then fight again. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, don't rush to secure the kill; create distance.
Trundle.laning: Early on, avoid forced fights even if it costs you some farm. Build a health lead with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks, but don't prolong the lane by repeatedly poking when Trundle P King's Tribute heals him. Once you've lowered his health, take an advantage immediately or push the wave to force a recall. After building a health lead, roam to another lane.
Trundle.combo: Hit with Akali Q Five Point Strike at its maximum range to slow him and create the Akali P Assassin's Mark ring. Step back across the ring, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Trundle.escape: The window to engage comes after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and Trundle W Frozen Domain has expired. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so use the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud along with Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution to close the gap.
Trundle.phase: Trundle has the advantage early because his basic attacks are strong, while Akali lacks armor and energy.
Trundle.teamfight: Do not engage teamfights first as Akali. Go in after your allies engage and draw the enemy's attention and crowd control. Instead of hitting a tankier Trundle while Trundle R Subjugate is active, pick off a squishy backliner. Avoid taking fights in narrow paths where Trundle E Pillar of Ice can easily block your escape.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, stay outside his basic attack range: one basic attack will stun you.
TwistedFate.build: Complete one ability power core item first so you can pick off backline targets. If you need defensive stats, build magic resistance against Twisted Fate's ability damage.
TwistedFate.fight: Poke with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross the passive ring, then return with an empowered basic attack to trade damage. When the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has been used, or he is holding a blue or red card, close the gap with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution.
TwistedFate.laning: Even if you miss some farm, build a health lead with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks. Once ahead, push the wave and roam to another lane.
TwistedFate.combo: Create the passive ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then land an empowered basic attack.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is your chance to engage.
TwistedFate.phase: After completing one ability power core item, you can pick off backline targets, but you still risk dying late in the game if you fail to finish the kill.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Enter the backline after your allies engage and Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's yellow card has been used. Twisted Fate has low health and defensive stats, so look to dash onto him with Akali and pick him off. If you can predict where Twisted Fate R Destiny will land, establish vision there ahead of time and wait.

Udyr.watch: Right after Udyr activates Udyr E Blazing Stampede, watch for the stun on his first attack. Keep your distance so you don't endure the empowered basic attacks of Udyr Q Wilding Claw and the slow and damage based on maximum health from Udyr R Wingborne Storm for long. While Udyr E Blazing Stampede is awakened, immobilizing effects don't work on him, so try to control him after it ends.
Udyr.build: Early on, survive with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Udyr's damage is mostly physical and Akali's armor is relatively low, so build armor first. If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle lets him endure fights, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Udyr.fight: Start a fight just after Udyr has used the movement and stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Hit with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow him and create the Akali P Assassin's Mark ring, then step outside the ring and return with an empowered basic attack. When the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, press the attack without giving him time to heal.
Udyr.laning: Udyr shows up through jungle ganks, so place vision along key paths and at jungle entrances, and don't move forward when he is out of sight. If you've built a health lead with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks, push the wave and roam to another lane.
Udyr.combo: If Udyr has used the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then land an empowered basic attack.
Udyr.escape: Akali's window to engage comes just after Udyr has used the movement and stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Close the gap with the stealth and movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud or with Akali E Shuriken Flip.
Udyr.phase: After completing one ability power core item, target the backline, but keep in mind throughout the game that Akali is at risk if she fails to finish the kill.
Udyr.teamfight: Let your team start the teamfight, then enter after the enemy's attention and crowd control have been spent. Pick off a vulnerable enemy behind Udyr first instead of focusing damage on him when he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle. Before engaging, check whether he has used the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Deal with Udyr after gaining a numbers advantage.

Urgot.watch: Urgot E Disdain is a dash with a stun and shield. Avoid its path, then take the opportunity right after he uses it. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, a strong slow and targeting from Urgot W Purge follow, so decide immediately whether to escape with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali W Twilight Shroud as it flies toward you. Do not stay near Urgot for long because of Urgot P Echoing Flames. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of its range before you reach the execution threshold.
Urgot.build: Early on, survive with Cloth Armor. Urgot's main damage is physical and Akali's armor is low, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Urgot.fight: Bait out Urgot E Disdain, then close the gap for a short fight. Create a ring with the edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its boundary, then land an empowered basic attack with its increased range. Don't prolong the fight near Urgot; move back out of his short range.
Urgot.laning: As you level Akali Q Five Point Strike, build a health lead with its edge and empowered basic attacks. Once ahead, push the wave and roam to another lane. When a direct fight is difficult, catch him with your jungler or farm.
Urgot.combo: When Urgot E Disdain is down, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Urgot.escape: The moment after Urgot E Disdain is used is your window to engage. Dodge Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Urgot.phase: Early on, Akali lacks armor and energy, so she can easily lose direct trades with Urgot. In the mid to late game, she can pick off backline targets after completing an ability power core item, but failing to finish the kill is dangerous. Enter after Urgot has used his crowd control.
Urgot.teamfight: Let your team initiate, then enter the backline with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution after the enemy's attention and crowd control have been spent. Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits and cannot cross terrain, so position a frontliner or wall between you and Urgot before engaging to limit his angle.

Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge. If trapped inside, move within it and wait for it to disappear instead of rushing across the edge. Veigar W Dark Matter marks where it will land, so watch the ground indicator and sidestep. If you fall below half health, move out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which grows stronger based on your missing health.
Veigar.build: Get movement speed first so you can walk out of the marked area of Veigar W Dark Matter. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance because all of Veigar's damage is magic damage.
Veigar.fight: Step outside the ring, then return with an empowered basic attack to gain a health advantage. Once Veigar E Event Horizon is down, close the gap with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Veigar.laning: Stand behind minions to avoid unnecessary hits from Veigar Q Baleful Strike that give him stacks of Veigar P Phenomenal Evil Power. Once you have a health advantage, push the wave and roam to another lane.
Veigar.combo: Use Akali Q Five Point Strike to create a passive ring, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Veigar.escape: Veigar has no mobility skill to create distance, so the moment Veigar E Event Horizon is down is your chance to engage. If trapped, move inside instead of crossing its edge blindly, and save Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution for your escape.
Veigar.phase: Veigar gains permanent stacks and grows stronger over time, so late in the game, check his position and whether he has used Veigar E Event Horizon before fighting.
Veigar.teamfight: Let your team initiate, then enter the backline after Veigar E Event Horizon and other crowd control have been used.

Vex.watch: If the fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is ready, her basic abilities can fear you and interrupt the dashes from Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution, so delay your engage. If a dash applies a Gloom mark to you, move out of Vex's basic attack range and wait for it to disappear. Vex E Looming Darkness covers a larger area at longer range, so if you are already close, dodge it with a short sidestep.
Vex.build: Complete a core ability power item first to exploit Vex's low magic resistance. Build magic resistance over armor, and consider movement speed to dodge her telegraphed area attacks and tenacity against her fear.
Vex.fight: Hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to create a ring, step back across it, then return to trade with an empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark. Engage after the fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom has been used on the wave or for poke and the shield from Vex W Personal Space is down. While Vex R Shadow Surge is down, she cannot use her ultimate to move, giving you a chance to close the gap.
Vex.laning: After leveling Akali Q Five Point Strike, look for a health advantage with its tip and empowered basic attacks from Akali P Assassin's Mark. Even if you miss some farm, once you have a health advantage, push the wave and roam to another lane.
Vex.combo: When the fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom and Vex W Personal Space are down, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross its edge, and land an empowered basic attack from Akali P Assassin's Mark.
Vex.escape: Right after the fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom is used is your window to engage with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution. If Vex W Personal Space is also down, you can catch her without a shield; while Vex R Shadow Surge is down, she has no mobility option either.
Vex.phase: Failing to finish Vex remains dangerous late in the game, so confirm her fear and shield are down before engaging.
Vex.teamfight: Let your team initiate, then enter the backline after the fear from Vex P Doom 'n Gloom and other crowd control have been used. Move low-health allies out of range of Vex R Shadow Surge first to prevent an ultimate reset from her first kill. If Akali is marked by Vex R Shadow Surge, move toward your team to create a chance to catch Vex together when she dashes in.

Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion can heal him and become empowered, so avoid forcing a trade when he uses it. When Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. If Vladimir R Hemoplague infects you, you take increased damage, so re-engage after its effect ends.
Vladimir.build: Vladimir's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If fights run long because of healing from Vladimir Q Transfusion, Vladimir W Sanguine Pool, and Vladimir R Hemoplague, apply healing reduction with Morellonomicon. Also consider Liandry's Torment for its damage based on maximum health against a Vladimir who has built health.
Vladimir.fight: Hit with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Vladimir and create a passive ring, then step back across it and trade with an empowered basic attack. Once Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, close the gap with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution and finish the fight quickly. Vladimir also moves more slowly while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, giving you a chance to close the gap.
Vladimir.laning: Once you have an advantage, push the wave and roam to another lane.
Vladimir.combo: Create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Vladimir.escape: Vladimir has no skill to create distance, so draw out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool before engaging. If you close in with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution as the pool ends, Vladimir will struggle to escape.
Vladimir.phase: If given time, Vladimir gains both health and ability power and becomes harder to face, so make the most of early advantages.
Vladimir.teamfight: Do not initiate the teamfight yourself. Let your team initiate, then enter the backline after the enemy's attention has been drawn and their crowd control has been spent. If infected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, step back and re-engage after its effect ends, and avoid grouping with allies inside its area. Confirm that Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down before using your decisive abilities.

Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a line, so avoid standing in line with the wave and sidestep it. Staying inside Viktor W Gravity Field stuns you, so use Akali E Shuriken Flip to leave as soon as it appears and do not keep trading inside it. Account for the shield and movement speed from Viktor Q Siphon Power when engaging.
Viktor.build: The source does not specify a first purchase or purchase order. Viktor's main damage is magic, so choose magic resistance if you build resistance. Movement speed also matters for walking out of Viktor W Gravity Field and telegraphed area attacks.
Viktor.fight: After dodging Viktor W Gravity Field, close the gap using the movement speed bonus from Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali E Shuriken Flip.
Viktor.laning: Avoid standing on the wave to give Viktor fewer angles to poke with Viktor E Hextech Ray. Even if you lose some farm, build a health advantage with Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks. Once ahead, push the wave and roam to another lane.
Viktor.escape: Viktor has no dash to escape on his own, so dodging Viktor W Gravity Field creates an engage opportunity. If he places it during your engage, leave its area immediately. Before recasting Akali E Shuriken Flip, check whether Viktor has moved under his turret or into the enemy team.
Viktor.phase: Viktor grows stronger over time, so when the color of the light on his staff changes, reassess the same trade.
Viktor.teamfight: Let your team start the fight, then engage on Viktor in the backline after the enemy's attention has been drawn and their crowd control has been spent. Avoid the area of Viktor W Gravity Field and close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.

Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash closes the gap quickly and stuns with an empowered basic attack, so stay outside basic attack range until it expires. When the marker for Volibear E Sky Splitter appears, sidestep to avoid the damage and slow. When Volibear R Stormbringer is available, do not stay under your turret at low health; if you see him leap, use Akali E Shuriken Flip to leave the landing area.
Volibear.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Volibear's main damage is physical, so build armor first. If healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul lets him sustain through fights, get Morellonomicon for healing reduction.
Volibear.fight: Hit with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Volibear and create a passive ring, then step back across the ring and return with an empowered basic attack from its extended range. If Volibear Q Thundering Smash is active, use the stealth and movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud to stay outside basic attack range until it expires.
