Avoid long fights that give Volibear W Frenzied Maul a chance to heal him; go in briefly when you can finish him.
Volibear.laning: After that, build a health advantage with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks. Give up some farm if necessary to avoid unfavorable fights. Once you have a health advantage, push the wave and roam to another lane.
Volibear.combo: Create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then land an empowered basic attack.
Volibear.escape: Avoid the stun and charge from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, then engage. If Volibear R Stormbringer is also down, use the window before it comes back up to close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Volibear.phase: Once you complete one core ability power item, you can take out backline targets. Failing to finish a target remains dangerous late, so do not make a definitive claim about which champion is stronger then.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear is building passive stacks by hitting minions or monsters, do not take the fight; wait for the stacks to fall off. Do not start teamfights as Akali. Let your allies engage, then take out a vulnerable backline target after the enemy's attention and crowd control have been spent. Use a mobility ability such as Akali E Shuriken Flip to leave the landing area of Volibear R Stormbringer.

Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so move well to the side when you see him charging it. A stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb can leave you open to his entire follow-up, so watch for it especially before going in. Avoid the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction, and start dodging as soon as you see Xerath cast Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.
Xerath.build: First, get a way to remove or break free from the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb. If you need resistance afterward, build magic resistance. There is no reason to buy armor against Xerath's ability damage.
Xerath.fight: Early on, do not force a fight from long range. Change direction while Xerath charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse to dodge it and close the gap. Once Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, use the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud and the dash from Akali E Shuriken Flip to get on him. Then create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross its edge, and return with an empowered basic attack.
Xerath.laning: Xerath Q Arcanopulse can hit you through minions, so watch for the charge and move sideways. After Xerath has spent a lot of mana, push the lane and call your jungler; if you have a health advantage, roam to another lane.
Xerath.combo: For a short trade, hit with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to create a ring, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack from its extended range.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility ability, so the moment after the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb and the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your chance to go in. Use Akali W Twilight Shroud for movement speed, then close the gap with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution. If Xerath is casting Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, you can also move onto his position while he cannot move.
Xerath.phase: Once you complete one core ability power item, you can target the backline, but failing to finish a target is dangerous, so check your entry point.
Xerath.teamfight: Do not start the teamfight. Let your allies engage, then go in after the enemy's attention and crowd control have been spent. Check especially that Xerath E Shocking Orb is down before using Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution to reach the backline.

Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare a tornado, back out of range and wait for the stacks to expire. If health is around half after Yone comes in with Yone E Soul Unbound, create distance before he returns, since the return deals additional damage.
Yone.build: Complete one core ability power item first to gain finishing power. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so do not focus on only one type of resistance. Also consider movement speed to leave the marked attack areas.
Yone.fight: Hit with the outer edge of Akali Q Five Point Strike to slow Yone and create a passive ring, then step back across the ring and return with an empowered basic attack. When you see the shield from Yone W Spirit Cleave, do not force an engage. Lower his health to increase the finishing damage from Akali R Perfect Execution.
Yone.laning: As Akali Q Five Point Strike gains levels, build a health advantage with its outer edge and empowered basic attacks. Then push the wave and roam to another lane.
Yone.combo: Create a passive ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, cross its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Yone.escape: Dodge the gust of wind from Yone Q Mortal Steel and go in during the window when Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed are down. If only one of Yone's movement options is down, he can escape with the other, so check what he still has before using Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Yone.phase: Look for a health and CS lead in lane to delay Yone's item growth. Even late in the game, failing to finish him off as Akali is dangerous.
Yone.teamfight: Let your allies start the fight, then use Akali W Twilight Shroud to target a vulnerable backline champion after the enemy's attention and crowd control have been spent. Spread out so Yone W Spirit Cleave does not hit several of you at once. Yone R Fate Sealed moves him behind the last champion it hits, so do not stand alone at the very back of your formation.

Zed.watch: Watch the position of Zed W Living Shadow and move outside the slow radius of the shadow's Zed E Shadow Slash. If Zed R Death Mark lands, create distance so Zed cannot add more damage. Zed P Contempt for the Weak deals magic damage based on maximum health, so armor alone will not stop it.
Zed.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to withstand Zed's physical damage early. Choose Plated Steelcaps and prioritize armor for defensive stats. Akali's main damage is magic, and Zed's magic resistance is relatively low.
Zed.fight: Repeat short trades: cross the ring, then return with an empowered basic attack. Commit to fighting once Zed W Living Shadow is down.
Zed.laning: Early on, preserve health even if you miss some CS. Build a health advantage with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks. Watch Zed's shadow position to avoid the slow from Zed E Shadow Slash. Once you have a health advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Zed.combo: If Zed W Living Shadow is down, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across it, then land an empowered basic attack.
Zed.escape: Look for an opening after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow and the shadow disappears or Zed has already swapped positions. If only Zed W Living Shadow is down, he can escape with Zed R Death Mark, so especially look to engage before Zed R Death Mark is available again. Use Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution to close the gap.
Zed.phase: Zed peaks in the mid game and weakens as the game goes late. After that, group with your team so no one is caught alone.
Zed.teamfight: Do not start teamfights as Akali. After your team engages and the enemy's attention and crowd control have been spent, enter the backline and take out a squishy target. Before going in, check whether the enemy's targeted crowd control is down and consider the risk if you fail to finish the target.

Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on maximum health, so watch the projectile's path and dodge it. If Yorick W Dark Procession traps you, break the wall with attacks or dash over it with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution. If the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick.
Yorick.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps. Prioritize armor against Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers' physical damage. If healing from Yorick Q Last Rites makes it hard to finish an all-in, buy Morellonomicon for healing reduction.
Yorick.fight: Clear the Mist Walkers before fighting Yorick, and do not start a fight where many graves have built up. If you dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist, use the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to create a ring, step back across it, then take a short trade with an empowered basic attack. If Yorick W Dark Procession is also down, use Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution to close the gap.
Yorick.laning: Watch for places where enemies die near Yorick and graves build up. When possible, push the wave to prevent Yorick from building graves on his side. Even if you miss some farm, build a health advantage with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks, then push the wave and move to another lane.
Yorick.combo: The basic trade is to create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its boundary, then return with an empowered basic attack at increased range.
Yorick.escape: Go in after dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist while Yorick W Dark Procession is down. Yorick has no mobility ability, so this is a good time to close the gap with Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution.
Yorick.phase: After completing one ability power core item, you can take out backline targets, but failing to finish them is dangerous. Choose your engages carefully even in the late game.
Yorick.teamfight: Do not start teamfights as Akali. Wait for your team to engage and draw the enemy's attention and crowd control, then take out a squishy backline target. Do not fight Yorick himself for long while his Mist Walkers and Maiden of the Mist are also involved in the fight. When Yorick pushes a side lane, consider catching the wave, then quickly joining your team or taking an objective elsewhere.

Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you fall asleep shortly afterward, and your magic resistance decreases during that time. Even if the bubble misses, watch narrow paths and brush entrances so you do not step on the trap it leaves behind. Zoe R Portal Jump returns her to her starting point, so aim for that spot.
Zoe.build: Get movement speed first to make Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble easier to dodge, and aim to complete an ability power core item for offense. If you need defensive stats, build magic resistance over armor. However, magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble.
Zoe.fight: Then create a ring with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back, and return with an empowered basic attack to build a health advantage. When Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, close the gap using the movement speed from Akali W Twilight Shroud and a dash from Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution.
Zoe.laning: Early on, seek a health advantage with the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike and empowered basic attacks, even if you miss some CS. If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, move behind a wall or an ally before the sleep triggers to get out of the angle and range of Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Once you have a health advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Zoe.combo: For a short trade, create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its boundary, then return with an empowered basic attack.
Zoe.escape: The moment Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble goes down is an opening to engage. While Zoe R Portal Jump is down, you can also close the gap with Akali E Shuriken Flip or Akali R Perfect Execution. If Zoe R Portal Jump moves her briefly, aim for the starting point she will return to.
Zoe.phase: After completing one ability power core item, you can target the backline, but failing to finish the target is dangerous.
Zoe.teamfight: Go in after your team starts the fight and the enemy's attention and crowd control have been spent. If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, use Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution to reach Zoe and take her out.

Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so sidestep it when Yasuo approaches. After he lands it twice, the next cast sends out a tornado that knocks you up. Watch for its sound and visual effect, dodge early, and beware of Yasuo R Last Breath.
Yasuo.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo's main damage is physical, so build armor first.
Yasuo.fight: Use the tip of Akali Q Five Point Strike to remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer shield first, then trade with empowered basic attacks by crossing your passive ring. Engage after Yasuo has fired his tornado, while he briefly has no way to knock you up.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin on your side to give Yasuo fewer minions to use as stepping stones with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Once you have a health advantage, push the wave and move to another lane.
Yasuo.combo: Create a ring with Akali Q Five Point Strike, step back across its edge, then return with an empowered basic attack. If Akali E Shuriken Flip hits, cross the ring and land an empowered basic attack, then check Yasuo's position before recasting E to close in again.
Yasuo.escape: Look to engage right after Yasuo sends out his tornado. Do not go in immediately just because Yasuo E Sweeping Blade alone has been used. Before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up, close the distance with crowd control and Akali W Twilight Shroud, E Shuriken Flip, and R Perfect Execution.
Yasuo.phase: The given information is not enough to determine who wins the late-game one-on-one, so choose your engage timing carefully in teamfights.
Yasuo.teamfight: Do not start the teamfight yourself. Wait for your allies to engage, draw the enemy's attention, and cause the enemy to spend their crowd control. Once you confirm their targeted crowd control has been used, go for a vulnerable backline target, accounting for the risk that you may fail to finish them.
